text: These pole tops, with an **upside down triangle** shape, are a good clue for Albania.
NOTE: Serbia, Czechia, Slovakia and Romania use similar pole tops.
text_zh: 這些電線桿頂部呈**倒三角形**狀，是判斷阿爾巴尼亞的好線索。
注意：塞爾維亞、捷克、斯洛伐克和羅馬尼亞使用類似的電線桿頂部。

text: Other, more simple Albanian pole tops will often have **horizontal bars**.
NOTE: If you are not sure between Montenegro or Albania and see these poles, guess Albania.
text_zh: 其他更簡約的阿爾巴尼亞電線桿頂部通常會有**橫桿**。
注意：如果你不確定是蒙特內哥羅還是阿爾巴尼亞，且看到這些電線桿，請猜阿爾巴尼亞。

text: Andorran snow poles are made out of **wood** and can have a variety** **of** colours** on them.
text_zh: 安道爾的雪樁由**木頭**製成，上面可能有各種**顏色**。

text: Round concrete poles sustaining three electricity lines in an **alternating pattern** are very common in Argentina.
**Doubled up poles** like in the second image is also a good clue for Argentina.
NOTE: Similar doubled concrete poles can occasionally be found throughout [Bolivia](https://goo.gl/maps/9soPnAuBufSD1GmH7).
text_zh: 支撐三條電線並呈**交錯排列**的圓形水泥桿在阿根廷非常常見。
如下圖二所示的**雙併電線桿**也是阿根廷的一個好線索。
注意：類似的雙併水泥桿偶爾也能遍及 [玻利維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/9soPnAuBufSD1GmH7) 全境。

text: Wooden poles are somewhat common in Argentina, they can be found either with a crossbar or without.
NOTE: Wooden A-frame poles in South America are only found in Argentina.
text_zh: 木桿在阿根廷還算常見，它們可能帶有橫桿，也可能沒有。
注意：南美洲的A字形木桿只在阿根廷有。

text: Within Argentina, these Latvian style **wooden** hook poles are unique to La Rioja and Mendoza.
text_zh: 在阿根廷境內，這種拉脫維亞風格的**木製**掛鉤電線桿是拉里奧哈省和門多薩省獨有的。

text: In Mendoza, poles with a **single insulator **attached to the side of the pole can be found.
text_zh: 在門多薩省，可以找到電線桿側面附有**單一絕緣子**的電線桿。

text: **White** **vertical pole stickers** with several **digits** can be found in Tucumán.
text_zh: 在圖庫曼可以找到帶有幾個**數字**的**白色****垂直桿貼紙**。

text: The iconic **Stobie pole**, made of steel and concrete, is specific to South Australia. The [pole tops](https://goo.gl/maps/Le5eiGxw9bRT1UQJA) (trident or rotated letter “E”) are also unique.
NOTE: A few thousand of these poles can be found in other states, most notably Tasmania.
text_zh: 由鋼材與混凝土製成的標誌性 **Stobie 電線桿**是南澳州特有的。其[電線桿頂部](https://goo.gl/maps/Le5eiGxw9bRT1UQJA)（三叉戟狀或旋轉的字母「E」）也是獨一無二的。
備註：在其他州也可以找到數千根這種電線桿，最明顯的是塔斯馬尼亞。

text: These **rusty metal poles**, containing several holes, are unique to the Northern Territory.
NOTE: These poles can also sometimes be found in some areas of northern WA, such as Wyndham.
text_zh: 這些帶有數個孔洞的**生鏽金屬電線桿**是北領地特有的。
備註：這些電線桿有時也會出現在西澳州北部的某些地區，例如溫德姆（Wyndham）。

text: According to a [2006 review](https://era.daf.qld.gov.au/id/eprint/3071/2/dpiandena_timber_pole_review06-sec.pdf#page=37), 64% of all **concrete poles** are located in the state of Victoria.
text_zh: 根據一份 [2006 年的文獻](https://era.daf.qld.gov.au/id/eprint/3071/2/dpiandena_timber_pole_review06-sec.pdf#page=37)，所有**水泥電線桿**中有 64% 位於維多利亞州。

text: A **trident-like** pole top can sometimes be seen in Western Australia and Victoria. In Western Australia, the pole will often have red insulators and black paint on the crossbar (shown in the image).

For the meta to work, all 3 insulators must be connected to the crossbar. This [link ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LLZCJkuNYMoqU13m6)shows a similar looking pole that is incorrect, as the middle insulator is connected to the pole itself rather than to the crossbar.
text_zh: 在西澳州與維多利亞州，有時可以看到**三叉戟狀**的電線桿頂部。在西澳州，電線桿的橫樑上通常會有紅色絕緣子和黑色塗漆（如圖所示）。
要讓這個線索特徵成立，所有 3 個絕緣子都必須連接到橫樑上。這個[連結 ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LLZCJkuNYMoqU13m6)顯示了一根看起來相似但不符合條件的電線桿，因為中間的絕緣子是連接到電線桿本身而非橫樑。

text: Queensland features these unique pole tops with coils that are **angled upwards** on the sides.
text_zh: 昆士蘭州的特色是擁有這種獨特的電線桿頂部，兩側的線圈**向上傾斜**。

text: Victorian pole tops feature 3 circular coils; 2 on the sides, and 1 vertical one at the top. At times, other [extensions](https://goo.gl/maps/p8m8EP5gHfnEgxyV7) can be seen on these poles.
text_zh: 維多利亞州的電線桿頂部有 3 個圓形線圈：兩側各 1 個，頂部有 1 個垂直的。有時在這些電線桿上可以看到其他的[延伸結構](https://goo.gl/maps/p8m8EP5gHfnEgxyV7)。

text: Poletops in Tasmania often consist of a **thin metal crossbar** **bent 90 degrees** to form an **L-shape.**
NOTE: Regular Australian crossbars are usually made out of [wood](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3nvo8eN8rPtWV9B9).
text_zh: 塔斯馬尼亞的電線桿頂部通常由**細金屬橫樑****彎曲 90 度**組成，呈現 **L 形。**
備註：澳洲一般的橫樑通常是由[木頭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3nvo8eN8rPtWV9B9)製成的。

text: Circular **blue** stickers can be found on Queensland poles. You may occasionally see the same type of sticker in a [different colour](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UsntugJachBVdzvp6), or with the colour almost [completely faded](https://goo.gl/maps/buTdGYBCeYaShRgs5).
NOTE: Blue stickers can also be found on French poles.
text_zh: 昆士蘭州的電線桿上可以看到圓形的**藍色**貼紙。偶爾你可能會看到[不同顏色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UsntugJachBVdzvp6)的同款貼紙，或是顏色幾乎[完全褪色](https://goo.gl/maps/buTdGYBCeYaShRgs5)的貼紙。
備註：法國的電線桿上也可以找到藍色貼紙。

text: These **black markings** are specific to electricity poles in the region encompassing the cities of Gold Coast, Brisbane, and Sunshine Coast in Queensland. They are often accompanied by diagonal numbers.
text_zh: 這些**黑色標記**是昆士蘭州包含黃金海岸、布里斯本和陽光海岸等城市區域的電線桿特有的。它們通常伴隨著斜向排列的數字。

text: **Olive-green possum guards** are only found on electricity poles in Tasmania.
NOTE: Possum guards are found all over Australia. The colour is what distinguishes them.
text_zh: **橄欖綠色的負鼠防護罩**僅見於塔斯馬尼亞的電線桿上。
備註：防負鼠罩全澳洲都有，顏色才是區分它們的關鍵。

text: Poles in Western Australia often have **green **painted bases, and sometimes a white sticker or a [red and white](https://goo.gl/maps/3G4CJepKWTr6Zw1e7) band attached.
text_zh: 西澳州的電線桿基座通常漆成**綠色 **，有時還會貼有白色貼紙或[紅白相間](https://goo.gl/maps/3G4CJepKWTr6Zw1e7)的條帶。

text: You can find these white hydrant poles that feature a** blue circle** and a red section on top of it in Victoria.
text_zh: 你可以在維多利亞州看到這些帶有**藍色圓形**且頂部為紅色的白色消防栓桿。

text: Melbourne poles commonly feature these white, rectangular stickers, with a smaller **blue square **inside it.
text_zh: 墨爾本的電線桿通常貼有這種白色長方形貼紙，中間有一個較小的**藍色正方形 **。

text: South Australian style **Stobie poles** can sometimes be found in the NSW town of Broken Hill.
text_zh: 南澳風格的**斯托比電線桿**有時可以在新南威爾斯州的布羅肯希爾鎮看到。

text: Austria uses white** **bollards, with a **black top**. The colour of the reflector is **(dark) red or dark grey**.
Many bollards also feature a small nipple-shaped black cap on the top. Bollards sometimes have a [snow pole on top](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8).
NOTE: Slovenia and Montenegro use the same bollards, but with bright red reflectors instead of grey or dark red. Germany uses simple white bollards with grey reflectors.
text_zh: 奧地利使用白色** **路樁，帶有**黑色頂部**。反光片的顏色為**（深）紅色或深灰色**。
許多路樁頂部還有一個突起的黑色小蓋。路樁頂部有時會附有[除雪桿](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8)。
註：斯洛維尼亞和蒙特內哥羅使用相同的路樁，但反光片為鮮紅色，而非灰色或深紅色。德國則使用帶有灰色反光片的簡約白色路樁。

text: Round **wooden** poles are the most common type of pole found in Austria.
text_zh: 圓形**木製**電線桿是奧地利最常見的電線桿類型。

text: These **yellow **natural gas poles, which resemble snow poles, are unique to Austria.
text_zh: 這些看起來像雪桿的**黃色**天然氣桿是奧地利獨有的。

text: Bus stops consisting of **neon-yellow poles** are found in Vorarlberg.
text_zh: 由**螢光黃色桿子**組成的公車站牌可在福拉爾貝格邦找到。

text: These **yellow and white stripes** around poles and signposts are found in Vorarlberg.
text_zh: 柱子和標誌桿上的這些**黃白相間條紋**出現在福拉爾貝格邦。

text: Poles in Vienna and [Innsbruck](https://goo.gl/maps/MWpqa8t1cVzunLrz9) feature these **red**-and-**white **pieces of tape that look like the Austrian flag. They can be differentiated by the fact that the tapes in [Vienna](https://goo.gl/maps/N4tkGXcAt1sbjxNy7) are thinner, and there are typically two on each pole.
text_zh: 維也納和[因斯布魯克](https://goo.gl/maps/MWpqa8t1cVzunLrz9)的電線桿上帶有這些**紅**與**白**相間膠帶，看起來像奧地利國旗。兩者可以這樣區分：[維也納](https://goo.gl/maps/N4tkGXcAt1sbjxNy7)的膠帶較細，且每根電線桿上通常有兩條。

text: Since the Azores is an autonomous region of Portugal, you will often come across various types of Portuguese infrastructure, such as poles, chevrons and bollards.
text_zh: 由於亞速群島是葡萄牙的自治區，你經常會遇到各種葡萄牙基礎設施，例如電線桿、轉彎標誌和路樁。

text: Most poles in Belgium are concrete, square shaped, and have tiny holes running up them. They often have** small metal wrappings** around them. The second most common type of pole has [**oval-shaped holes**](https://goo.gl/maps/XVRAYg1wmhNJQxg17). You can find many different types of concrete poles in Belgium.
NOTE: The small metal wrappings can be found in France as well.
text_zh: 比利時的大多數電線桿都是混凝土材質的方形桿，沿著桿身貫穿著小孔。它們周圍常常纏繞著**金屬包紮帶**。第二常見的電線桿類型有[**橢圓形孔**](https://goo.gl/maps/XVRAYg1wmhNJQxg17)。您可以在比利時找到許多不同類型的混凝土電線桿。
備註：金屬包紮帶在法國也能看到。

text: Traffic lights are most often supported by black-and-yellow or red-and-white **striped poles**.
NOTE: The regional differences are discussed in Step 2.
text_zh: 紅綠燈最常由黃黑相間或紅白相間的**條紋桿**支撐。
備註：區域差異將在步驟 2 中討論。

text: Traffic lights held up by **yellow-and-black** poles are unique to Flanders. In contrast, Wallonia and Brussels frequently use a **red-and-white** design.
text_zh: 由**黃黑相間**燈桿支撐的紅綠燈是法蘭德斯特有的。相比之下，瓦隆尼亞和布魯塞爾則經常使用**紅白相間**的設計。

text: **Thin** **metal poles** are occasionally found in Bhutan. They are often painted black at the bottom.
text_zh: 不丹偶爾會看到**細** **金屬桿**。它們底部通常漆成黑色。

text: Two types of **utility poles** are common in Bolivia:
- Round concrete poles, often with small pinholes near the top.
- Wooden poles.

Poles in Bolivia are very inconsistent and should not be relied on too much. Poles can have a variety of pole tops. On rare occasions, you can find [Argentina-style concrete poles](https://goo.gl/maps/UythNAbXVFHvDYp56).
text_zh: 玻利維亞常見兩種類型的**電線桿**：
- 圓形水泥桿，頂部附近通常有小針孔。
- 木桿。
玻利維亞的電線桿非常不一致，不應過度依賴。桿頂樣式多樣。在極少數情況下，你可以找到[阿根廷風格的水泥桿](https://goo.gl/maps/UythNAbXVFHvDYp56)。

text: Many wooden utility poles, particularly in the eastern parts of Bolivia’s Street View coverage, are noticeably **curvy **and look like they are made from locally sourced tree trunks.
NOTE: While you may see slightly bent poles in other places, extremely curvy poles are a very good clue for Bolivia.
text_zh: 許多木製電線桿，特別是在玻利維亞東部街景覆蓋區域，都明顯**彎曲 **，看起來就像是用當地樹幹製作的。
注意：雖然你可能在其他地方看到稍微彎曲的電線桿，但極度彎曲的電線桿是玻利維亞非常好的線索。

text: The most common poles in Brazil have some resemblance to a **ladder **in the bottom portion. They are rectangular, have long segments running through the bottom, and small holes near the top.
NOTE: Paraguay uses similar poles.
text_zh: 巴西最常見的電線桿底部有點像**梯子**。它們呈矩形，底部有長條形切割，靠近頂部有小孔。
註：巴拉圭也使用類似的電線桿。

text: Alongside ladder poles, **round poles** can often be found across the south of Brazil, especially São Paulo. These poles are cylindrical and made of concrete.

NOTE: This map and the following wooden pole map was created using statistical analysis of semi-urban and rural locations. 434 locations of 3 poles per location were used across 16 states that were thought to have mixed poles. Regardless of the state, the centre of large cities will often have round poles.
text_zh: 除了梯形桿外，在巴西南部（尤其是聖保羅州）經常可以看到**圓形電線桿**。這些電線桿為圓柱形且由混凝土製成。
註：這張地圖以及接下來的木製電線桿地圖是透過對半城鎮與鄉村地點進行統計分析製作而成的。研究使用了 16 個被認為混用不同電線桿的州、共 434 個地點（每個地點取 3 根電線桿）。無論在哪個州，大城市的中心通常都會有圓形電線桿。

text: Some states also use **wooden poles**. They are most commonly seen in Rio Grande do Sul, Roraima, Amazonas, and Rio de Janeiro.
text_zh: 一些州也會使用**木製電線桿**。它們最常見於南里奧格蘭德州、羅賴馬州、亞馬遜州和里約熱內盧州。

text: Brazil often uses **supports **on its electricity poles that connect the crossbar to the stem of the pole. The frequency of pole supports varies greatly state-to-state. It is notably rare in the northeast.
NOTE: This tip only works for poles that have a crossbar.
text_zh: 巴西的電線桿經常使用**支撐桿 **將橫樑連接到桿身。電線桿支撐桿的出現頻率因州而異，在東北部尤其罕見。
註：此技巧僅適用於帶有橫樑的電線桿。

text: Poles with a **single support **are most commonly found in the states of Tocantins, Santa Catarina, and Minas Gerais.
text_zh: 帶有**單支撐桿 **的電線桿最常見於托坎廷斯州、聖卡塔琳娜州和米納斯吉拉斯州。

text: Markings on poles are used by the electricity companies to identify them. This pole ID is **long**, **yellow** **pole paint **with a black code. The ones that start with a letter are found in Bahia and Pernambuco.
text_zh: 電力公司會在電線桿上記號以供識別。這種電線桿編號是帶有黑色代碼的**長條**、**黃色** **電線桿塗漆 **。開頭為字母的編號可在巴伊亞州和伯南布哥州（Pernambuco）找到。

text: Similar to the Bahia and Pernambuco poles, Goiás poles also use **long, yellow pole paint **with a black paint code, but it always starts with a number. They also have a rarer yellow on black pole ID, which can be either paint or a plate.
text_zh: 與巴伊亞州和伯南布哥州的電線桿類似，戈亞斯州的電線桿也使用帶有黑色代碼的**長條黃色電線桿塗漆 **，但它總是以數字開頭。它們還有一種較罕見的黃底黑字電線桿編號，可以是塗漆或牌子。

text: This **small yellow or orange plate** attached onto the pole by thin metal or zip tie is found in Rio Grande do Norte and Pernambuco. This ID is usually much higher up the pole in Pernambuco than in Rio Grande do Norte.
text_zh: 這種用細金屬線或束帶固定在電線桿上的**小黃色或橘色牌子**出現在北里奧格蘭德州和伯南布哥州。這個編號在伯南布哥州的電線桿上通常位置高得多。

text: Pole IDs in Paraná are usually made up of **black paint** and yellow or white painted text.
text_zh: 巴拉那州的電線桿編號通常由**黑色塗漆**以及黃色或白色刷漆文字組成。

text: Most poles in Maranhão have a **small beige plate with numbers** built into the surface of the pole. This pole ID can be found in Pará and Piauí more rarely.
text_zh: 馬拉尼昂州（Maranhão）的大多數電線桿都有**嵌入電線桿表面的帶數字小米色牌**。這種電線桿編號在帕拉州和皮奧伊州較少見。

text: Utility poles in Paraná on intersections are sometimes **painted with the street name**. This can sometimes extend to Santa Catarina or Rio Grande do Sul if there are ladder poles in the city.
text_zh: 巴拉那州十字路口處的電線桿有時會**刷上路名**。如果城市裡有梯形電線桿，這種情況有時也會延伸到聖卡塔琳娜州或南里奧格蘭德州。

text: This poletop, consisting of an **asymmetrical crossbar** and a **support** reaching to the middle of the longer** **part of the crossbar, is the most common poletop in the state of São Paulo. It can also be frequently seen in the states of Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro and Mato Grosso do Sul.
text_zh: 這種桿頂結構由**不對稱橫樑**以及連接至橫樑較長** **部分的**支撐桿**組成，是聖保羅州最常見的桿頂結構。在南里奧格蘭德州、里約熱內盧州和南馬托格羅索州也經常可以看到。

text: This **asymmetrical** **crossbar** with **no supports** is exclusive to Ceara and Rondonia.
NOTE: While the crossbar in Ceara is usually made of concrete, the [Rondonian variation](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nXUtLu6sWXvN4zfF8) features a metal crossbar, and is far less common.
text_zh: 這種**不對稱** **橫樑**且**無支撐桿**的結構是塞阿拉州和朗多尼亞州（Rondônia）特有的。
註：雖然塞阿拉州的橫樑通常由混凝土製成，但[朗多尼亞州的變體](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nXUtLu6sWXvN4zfF8)採用金屬橫樑，且極不常見。

text: This pole configuration, featuring a zigzag-shaped top bar resting atop a flat crossbar, is exclusive to Ceara and Roraima. The pole is usually much larger than a regular electricity pole.
text_zh: 這種電線桿配置在扁平橫樑上方設有鋸齒狀頂桿，是塞阿拉州和羅賴馬州特有的。這種電線桿通常比普通電線桿大得多。

text: Poles that have a smooth cone on top, often called a **pencil pole**,** **are common in the state of Rio de Janeiro and rarely in Brasília and Manaus.
text_zh: 頂部有平滑圓錐體的電線桿（常被稱為**鉛筆桿**）** **在里約熱內盧州很常見，在巴西利亞和瑪瑙斯（Manaus）則很罕見。

text: **Gamma-shaped ("Γ")** poles containing **electricity boxes** at the end of the bar are most commonly seen in the state of Rio de Janeiro and in the cities of Belém, Salvador, Fortaleza and Maceió.
NOTE: A variation with a [shorter bar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AQ9y7AkQfqjh7KjV9) is exclusive to Belém.
text_zh: 橫樑末端帶有**電箱**的**伽瑪形（"Γ"）**電線桿最常見於里約熱內盧州，以及貝倫、薩爾瓦多、福塔雷薩（Fortaleza）和馬塞約（Maceió）等城市。
註：帶有[較短橫樑](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AQ9y7AkQfqjh7KjV9)的變體是貝倫特有的。

text: You may frequently see** electricity counters** attached to the poles in Cuiabá, Macapá and large cities in the state of Pará.
NOTE: The electricity counter may consist of one or [several ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cHRjDx6cB5YRJZHi7)compartments.
text_zh: 你可能會經常在庫亞巴（Cuiabá）、馬卡帕（Macapá）和帕拉州的大城市看到附掛在電線桿上的** 電表**。
註：電表可能由一個或[多個 ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cHRjDx6cB5YRJZHi7)分室組成。

text: Poles that have one insulator on top and **alternating** horizontal insulators can be found in Mato Grosso and southern Acre. It is also very rare in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 頂部有一個絕緣子且帶有**交錯**水平絕緣子的電線桿可以在馬托格羅索州和阿克里州南部找到。這在南里奧格蘭德州也極為罕見。

text: Insulators that resemble **brown mushrooms** are only found in Pernambuco.
text_zh: 外形酷似**棕色蘑菇**的絕緣子僅存在於伯南布哥州。

text: Insulators that resemble **white mushrooms** are found in Bahia and rarely Brasília.
text_zh: 外形酷似**白色蘑菇**的絕緣子出現在巴伊亞州，極少見於巴西利亞。

text: **Transparent** insulators are mostly in Alagoas in the northeast, and Santa Catarina in the south. They can be seen rarely in Sergipe, Ceará, and Brasília.
text_zh: **透明**絕緣子主要分佈在東北部的阿拉戈斯州（Alagoas）和南部的聖卡塔琳娜州。在塞爾希培州（Sergipe）、塞阿拉州和巴西利亞偶爾也能看到。

text: These insulators have a shape resembling a **spool of thread**. They are found mostly in Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo, and have been seen in Ceará.
text_zh: 這些絕緣子的形狀類似**線軸**。它們主要存在於里約熱內盧州和聖埃斯皮里圖州，也在塞阿拉州出現過。

text: Insulators in Ceará can sometimes be uniquely **long and thin**. They are in Goiás too, but are rare.
text_zh: 塞阿拉州的絕緣子有時會呈現獨特的**細長**形狀。它們在戈亞斯州也有，但很罕見。

text: Poles with **horizontal insulators** are very common in Pará and less so in Mato Grosso. They are rarely found in Acre, Amapá, Tocantins, Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 帶有**水平絕緣子**的電線桿在帕拉州非常常見，在馬托格羅索州則少一些。它們在阿克里州、阿馬帕州、托坎廷斯州、聖卡塔琳娜州和南里奧格蘭德州很少見。

text: **Long grey insulators**, not including when they are horizontal, are most commonly found in Pará, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, Bahia, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná and Santa Catarina.
They are found rarely in Maranhão, Rio Grande do Norte, Alagoas, Sergipe, Rondônia, and Rio Grande do Sul. Other states have between 0 and 5%.
text_zh: **灰色長絕緣子**（不包括水平安裝的情況）最常見於帕拉州、馬托格羅索州、托坎廷斯州、巴伊亞州、南馬托格羅索州、巴拉那州和聖卡塔琳娜州。
它們在馬拉尼昂州、北里奧格蘭德州、阿拉戈斯州、塞爾希培州、朗多尼亞州和南里奧格蘭德州很少見。其他州的出現率在 0% 到 5% 之間。

text: Poles with these **black double UFO-shaped insulators in a trident formation** are common in Maranhão. The insulator itself is common across many states, but not in this configuration.
text_zh: 帶有這種**三叉戟排列的黑色雙飛碟形絕緣子**的電線桿在馬拉尼昂州很常見。這種絕緣子本身在許多州都很常見，但不會是這種排列方式。

text: These insulators are spherical or cone shaped and suspended on a rod above the insulator bar. They are often referred to as **“lollipop” insulators**. They are very common in Rio Grande de Norte, Paraíba, Pernambuco, and more rarely, Sergipe.
text_zh: 這些絕緣子呈球形或錐形，懸掛在絕緣子桿上方的金屬棒上。它們通常被稱為**「棒棒糖」絕緣子**。它們在北里奧格蘭德州、帕拉伊巴州、伯南布哥州非常常見，在塞爾希培州較罕見。

text: These **dark brown insulators** with grey bases are found almost exclusively in Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 這些帶有灰色底座的**深棕色絕緣子**幾乎僅見於聖卡塔琳娜州和南里奧格蘭德州。

text: The vast majority of poles in Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Pará, Amapá, Rio Grande do Norte, Pernambuco and Santa Catarina have the **lamp arm attached** to the pole, as opposed to it being attached with a plate, which is much more common generally.
text_zh: 馬托格羅索州、南馬托格羅索州、帕拉州、阿馬帕州、北里奧格蘭德州、伯南布哥州和聖卡塔琳娜州的大多數電線桿都是**燈臂直接固定**在桿身，而非一般較常見的透過固定板連接。

text: Lamps in Ceará often have a **fancy and colourful arm**, whether as lampposts or attached to utility poles. It sometimes says the town on the arm.
text_zh: 塞阿拉州的路燈無論是獨立路燈桿還是附掛在電線桿上，通常都帶有**華麗且色彩鮮豔的燈臂**。燈臂上有時會印有城鎮名稱。

text: These spheres on top of utility poles are **João-de-Barro nests**. They are common across the south of Brazil.
text_zh: 電線桿頂部的這些球體是**棕灶鳥的巢**。它們在巴西南部很常見。

text: São Paulo has a **square, yellow** pole ID paint. It has three letters on top followed by two numbers, a black line, and four more numbers. The three letters represent the municipality within São Paulo, but are rarely visible.
text_zh: 聖保羅的電線桿上有**方形黃色**的編號噴漆。頂部有三個字母，後面跟著兩個數字、一條黑線和另外四個數字。這三個字母代表聖保羅州內的自治市，但很少能看清。

text: Street signs in [Campo Grande](https://goo.gl/maps/bP6rWChW4MMmzJS18) and [Joinville](https://goo.gl/maps/1UTu9TZ3KLZK4kxv7) are **stickers** wrapped around a pole at intersections. Campo Grande signs usually have extra information and a red and yellow stripe.
text_zh: 在[大坎普](https://goo.gl/maps/bP6rWChW4MMmzJS18)與[若茵維利](https://goo.gl/maps/1UTu9TZ3KLZK4kxv7)，路標是路口處包裹在桿子上的**貼紙**。大坎普的路標通常會有額外資訊以及紅黃相間的條紋。

text: Cuiaba lamps are usually a **light green**, and is one of the few cities that has poles with multiple electricity metres, sometimes 6 to 12.
text_zh: 庫亞巴的路燈通常是**淺綠色**，而且是少數電線桿上裝有多個電錶（有時多達 6 到 12 個）的城市之一。

text: Lamps in Caxias do Sul usually have a **zig-zag** bent pole and a yellow head.
text_zh: 南卡西亞斯的路燈通常有**鋸齒狀**彎曲的燈桿和黃色的燈頭。

text: Poles on Santa Catarina Island (Florianópolis) are painted **white** with **blue and red stripes**.
text_zh: 聖卡塔琳娜島（弗洛里亞諾波利斯）上的桿子被漆成**白色**，並帶有**藍紅相間條紋**。

text: Most utility poles in Bulgaria are **cylindrical **and made of **concrete**.
There is also a less common concrete ‘ladder pole’ variation. You can also sometimes see simple wooden poles.
text_zh: 保加利亞的大多數電線桿都是**圓柱形**且由**混凝土**製成。
還有一種較不常見的混凝土「梯形桿」變體。有時你也能看到簡易的木桿。

text: Most poles have small, alternating **hook-shaped** insulators.
text_zh: 大多數電線桿都有交錯排列的小型**鉤狀**絕緣子。

text: This style of pole top, with 3 large, alternating insulators that are shaped like **upward facing hooks**, is a good clue for Bulgaria. This pole top is probably unique to the country.
NOTE: You can also find this pole top with the insulators facing [downwards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/srfTSgJK7kcGUUQNA).
text_zh: 這種電線桿頂部的樣式帶有 3 個形狀像**朝上的鉤子**的大型交錯絕緣子，是辨識保加利亞的好線索。這種電線桿頂部大概是該國獨有的。
注意：你也可以找到絕緣子朝[下](https://maps.app.goo.gl/srfTSgJK7kcGUUQNA)的這種桿頂。

text: Two types of poles are common:
- Concrete** ladder** poles (so named because the indents and ridges resemble a ladder).
- Round concrete poles with small **holes**.
Rarely, you might see simple [wooden poles](https://goo.gl/maps/ffGjZufAA38brtLg6).
NOTE: The same type of round concrete pole is also common in [Vietnam](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mhQRGYEqaoehmkSr6).

You can easily distinguish between Thailand and Cambodia based on the poles. Thailand uses square concrete poles with rows of small pinholes on the sides. Such poles are very uncommon in Cambodia (but not [completely absent](https://goo.gl/maps/6YWqPhcJmHvYEFp78)).
text_zh: 常見的電線桿有兩種類型：
- 水泥**梯形**桿（因其凹槽和凸起看起來像梯子而得名）。
- 帶有小**孔**的圓形水泥桿。
極少數情況下，你可能會看到簡易的[木桿](https://goo.gl/maps/ffGjZufAA38brtLg6)。
注意：同款圓形水泥桿在[越南](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mhQRGYEqaoehmkSr6)也很常見。
你可以輕鬆根據電線桿來區分泰國和柬埔寨。泰國使用的是方形水泥桿，兩側有一排排小孔。這種電線桿在柬埔寨非常少見（但並非[完全沒有](https://goo.gl/maps/6YWqPhcJmHvYEFp78)）。

text: In the sections of Road 6 west of Siem Reap, to Sisophon, and Road 5, south of Sisophon to Krong Battambang, you can find power lines with **unique poles** that are found nowhere else in Cambodia. The pole tops have three horizontal beams, with hanging insulators** on only one side**. The bottom of the poles have [indents](https://goo.gl/maps/HPrch2sJ2uRi862a9).
text_zh: 在 Siem Reap 以西至 Sisophon 的 6 號道路路段，以及 Sisophon 以南至 Krong Battambang 的 5 號道路路段，你可以找到帶有**獨特電線桿**的輸電線路，這些電線桿在柬埔寨其他地方都看不到。桿頂有三根橫樑，懸掛絕緣子**僅位於單側**。電線桿底部帶有[凹槽](https://goo.gl/maps/HPrch2sJ2uRi862a9)。

text: The powerline from the previous tip continues on the section of Road 5 west of Sisophon. However, here the pole tops have insulators **on both sides**. The rest of the pole is identical however.
text_zh: 前一個提示中的輸電線路延伸至 Sisophon 以西的 5 號道路路段。不過，這裡的桿頂**兩側皆有**絕緣子。但電線桿的其餘部分完全相同。

text: North America primarily uses **wooden utility poles**.
Several European countries also primarily use wooden utility poles. However, a concrete pole in particular is mostly associated with Europe.
In addition, the US and Canada use transformers that are **large metallic cylinders**. This will never be seen in European countries.
text_zh: 北美主要使用**木製電線桿**。
幾個歐洲國家也主要使用木製電線桿。不過，水泥電線桿特別容易讓人聯想到歐洲。
此外，美國和加拿大使用的變壓器是**大型金屬圓柱體**。這在歐洲國家絕對看不到。

text: This style of insulator, which is raised slightly on top of the utility pole, can be a good clue for the US and Canada. It is not typically found in Europe. It is especially apparent on simple poles with a single insulator.
text_zh: 這種稍微架高在電線桿頂端的礙子樣式，是分辨美國和加拿大的好線索。在歐洲通常看不到這種樣式。在只有單個礙子的簡單電線桿上尤為明顯。

text: The transformers on poles will **face **the road in British Columbia and New Brunswick, while in [other provinces](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.597191,-71.9607213,3a,37.3y,356.7h,112.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1skt1xgBKW1zae9FlYAHS5lg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192), it will be **parallel **with the wires.
text_zh: 卑詩省和紐布倫斯威克省電線桿上的變壓器會**面向 **道路，而在[其他省份](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.597191,-71.9607213,3a,37.3y,356.7h,112.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1skt1xgBKW1zae9FlYAHS5lg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則會與電線**平行 **。

text: Transformers on Prince Edward Island and Nova Scotia will be installed at a 45° angle relative to the road. On PEI, red numbers will usually be written on the side.
text_zh: 愛德華王子島和新斯科細亞省的變壓器安裝角度與道路呈 45° 角。在愛德華王子島，側邊通常會寫有紅色數字。

text: Insulators facing **towards or away from the road** are mostly found in Québec, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Other provinces tend to have their insulators facing the same direction as the road.
NOTE: This is most trustworthy when the pole is not at an intersection or driveway.
text_zh: 礙子**朝向或背對道路**主要見於魁北克省、新斯科細亞省與愛德華王子島。其他省份的礙子則多半朝向與道路相同的方向。
註：當電線桿不在路口或車道旁時，此線索最為可靠。

text: These distinctive pole tops are most commonly found in Ontario. They have two insulators to the **side**, and one on **top**. The side insulators are affixed to the pole with a distinct** **attachment. Sometimes, multiple of them can be [stacked](https://goo.gl/maps/ZVECCo5w5KVtJRmT6) on top of each other.
NOTE: They can occasionally appear in British Columbia, Nova Scotia, or other provinces more rarely.
text_zh: 這些特殊的電線桿頂端最常見於安大略省。它們在**兩側**各有一個礙子，**頂端**則有一個。側邊礙子是用獨特的** **固定配件安裝在桿上。有時多組這樣的結構會互相[重疊堆疊](https://goo.gl/maps/ZVECCo5w5KVtJRmT6)。
註：它們偶爾會出現在卑詩省、新斯科細亞省，或是更罕見於其他省份。

text: Some Québec poles have recognizable pole tops with insulator rods that are **angled slightly upwards**.
text_zh: 部分魁北克省的電線桿頂端可辨識，其礙子棒**稍微向上傾斜**。

text: Pole top insulators in Saskatchewan **alternate**. While one pole will have one insulator on the left and two on the right, the next will have two on the left and one on the right.
NOTE: This can rarely be seen in [Manitoba](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JMD7VTJPjWEMyet77).
text_zh: 薩克其萬省的電線桿頂礙子會**交替出現**。當一根電線桿為左邊一個礙子、右邊兩個礙子時，下一根就會變成左邊兩個礙子、右邊一個礙子。
註：這在[曼尼托巴省](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JMD7VTJPjWEMyet77)極為罕見。

text: Poles with **two hanging insulators** are common in Manitoba.
text_zh: 帶有**兩個懸掛式礙子**的電線桿在曼尼托巴省很常見。

text: Québec poles may sometimes have a vertical **black and yellow **label. There is a small **‘Q’** in the black part.
text_zh: 魁北克省的電線桿有時帶有垂直的**黑黃相間 **標籤。黑色部分有一個小小的 **「Q」**。

text: Poles on Prince Edward Island usually feature a **small white sticker**.
text_zh: 愛德華王子島上的電線桿通常帶有**白色小貼紙**。

text: New Brunswick and Nova Scotia commonly use lampheads with a rectangular shape.
text_zh: 紐布倫斯威克省與新斯科細亞省常使用矩形的路燈燈頭。

text: Lamp arms on utility poles in Nova Scotia are usually curved and **much shorter** than in the [rest of Canada.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f8W98cYyaK7do5oa7)
NOTE: Short lamp arms may occasionally be found in other parts of Canada.
text_zh: 新斯科細亞省電線桿上的燈臂通常呈彎曲狀，且比[加拿大其他地區](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f8W98cYyaK7do5oa7)**短得多**。
註：短燈臂偶爾也會在加拿大的其他地區看到。

text: Chile uses square concrete poles with an **indent** on both sides. They are somewhat similar to Brazilian poles, however have fewer horizontal supports in the indent. The upper part typically has small pinholes.
Wooden poles are also fairly common.
text_zh: 智利使用兩側皆有**凹槽**的正方形混凝土電線桿。它們與巴西的電線桿有些相似，但在凹槽中的水平支撐較少。上部通常有小針孔。
木造電線桿也相當常見。

text: Poles in Arica feature **white** paint with a black number, while the other cities in the Atacama Desert feature poles with [**yellow**](https://goo.gl/maps/xfQm8JHGpC6VCDR47) paint. Keep in mind the paint may have faded, making it look white.
text_zh: 阿里卡 (Arica) 的電線桿特色是漆成**白色**並帶有黑色數字，而阿他加馬沙漠的其他城市則是漆成[**黃色**](https://goo.gl/maps/xfQm8JHGpC6VCDR47)的電線桿。請記住，漆料可能會褪色而看起來像白色。

text: **Round** poles with black paint can be seen in the town of El Salvador.
text_zh: 漆成黑色的**圓形**電線桿可以在薩爾瓦多鎮 (El Salvador) 看到。

text: Colombian poles are often marked with unique **black-and-yellow** or black-and-orange stripes.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞的電線桿通常標有獨特的**黑黃相間**或黑橘相間條紋。

text: Colombian poles are generally **concrete** with a variety of pole tops.
Moreover, dark-coloured poles are more common in Colombia than in neighbouring countries.
NOTE: It is the only country in the Americas, apart from Mexico and Ecuador, where octagonal poles can be found.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞的電線桿通常是**混凝土**製成，並搭配各種電線桿頂部。
此外，深色電線桿在哥倫比亞比鄰近國家更常見。
註：它是美洲中除了墨西哥和厄瓜多之外，唯一能找到八角形電線桿的國家。

text: These pole markings with one short black strip on the top and bottom, and a **longer yellow section** in the middle, are most commonly found in the Antioquia department. Sometimes, you can find them in the Cordoba department as well.
text_zh: 這些電線桿標記在頂部和底部各有一條短黑條，中間則有一個**較長的黃色區段**，最常在安蒂奧基亞省（Antioquia）找到。有時，你也可以在科 Córdoba 省找到它們。

text: Intersections in the coastal city of Barranquilla are commonly marked by **small concrete poles** (_mojones_) bearing street names. For example, this image was taken at the intersection of Carrera 42 and Calle 68.
text_zh: 沿海城市巴蘭幾亞的十字路口通常有印著街道名稱的**小混凝土柱**（_mojones_）作標記。例如，這張照片是在卡雷拉 42 街（Carrera 42）和卡列 68 街（Calle 68）的交叉口拍攝的。

text: Costa Rica uses **long silver insulators**.

NOTE: Panama uses a variety of insulators, some of which are also [long silver insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fVdRraxxpbLSgzWdA), they also use [short silver](https://maps.app.goo.gl/15arUFZ8Zi7XbEii7), [long black](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Ch37q5EZoLi7Xe9z9), [UFO](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GbzUD5YTpd9RXAb27) and [white mushroom](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2fAxTEEveNTe6Pdd9) insulators. Additionally, Brazil can have long silver insulators. Lastly, Ecuador uses UFO and mushroom insulators.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加使用**長銀色絕緣子**。

注意：巴拿馬使用各種絕緣子，其中有些也是[長銀色絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fVdRraxxpbLSgzWdA)，他們也使用[短銀色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/15arUFZ8Zi7XbEii7)、[長黑色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Ch37q5EZoLi7Xe9z9)、[幽浮（UFO）](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GbzUD5YTpd9RXAb27)和[白色蘑菇](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2fAxTEEveNTe6Pdd9)絕緣子。此外，巴西也可能出現長銀色絕緣子。最後，厄瓜多使用幽浮和蘑菇絕緣子。

text: One of the most common pole tops is an even crossbar with uneven insulators, meaning there is one on one side and two on the other. Additionally, the crossbar is further down on the pole than usual.

NOTE: 2 on 1 insulator poles with a low crossbar can also be found in Panama. However, poles in Costa Rica usually feature support bars, while this is much more rare on [Panamanian poles.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nUBSxGGYTvWqCygu8)
text_zh: 最常見的電線桿頂部之一是平坦的橫樑配上不對稱的絕緣子，也就是一側有一個、另一側有兩個。此外，橫樑在電線桿上的位置比平常更低。
注意：帶有低橫樑的 2 對 1 絕緣子電線桿也可以在巴拿馬找到。然而，哥斯大黎加的電線桿通常具有支撐桿，而這在[巴拿馬電線桿上](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nUBSxGGYTvWqCygu8)非常罕見。

text: Poles that have a single insulator attached to the side at the top of the pole are commonly found in Costa Rica.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加常見到電線桿頂部側邊附有一個單一絕緣子的電線桿。

text: Utility poles in Costa Rica feature a lamp with a blue dot on the top, similarly to other Latin American countries like Panama, Colombia and Brazil.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加的電線桿上有一個頂部帶有藍點的燈具，這點與巴拿馬、哥倫比亞和巴西等其他拉丁美洲國家類似。

text: Also common is this thin metal crossbar that is bent 90 degrees to form an L-shape.
NOTE: Also commonly found in Panama, Colombia and Ecuador. However, poles with crossbars are generally not as common in Panama as they are in Costa Rica.
text_zh: 這種彎曲 90 度形成 L 型的細金屬橫樑也很常見。
注意：這在巴拿馬、哥倫比亞和厄瓜多也很常見。然而，附有橫樑的電線桿在巴拿馬通常不像在哥斯大黎加那麼普遍。

text: Poles are sometimes marked with large [black](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VcCnYBtpTctWDzPj8) or [white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BLrafkVmtcoLRzqMA) stickers, containing multiple lines of text. The **first digit **of the topmost number is province-specific.

_For more specific information, please see this research _[document](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1v0JPX6oGBOsDQ8x68jGbO3LpWcwU9UcNn9GV3bcwW1M/edit?slide=id.g3790a800eb2_0_129#slide=id.g3790a800eb2_0_129)_ created by L’Heureux Traité._
text_zh: 電線桿上有時會標上大型的[黑色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VcCnYBtpTctWDzPj8)或[白色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BLrafkVmtcoLRzqMA)貼紙，上面有多行文字。最上方數字的**第一個數字**是各省特有的。
_如需更多具體資訊，請參閱 L’Heureux Traité 製作的這份研究_[文件](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1v0JPX6oGBOsDQ8x68jGbO3LpWcwU9UcNn9GV3bcwW1M/edit?slide=id.g3790a800eb2_0_129#slide=id.g3790a800eb2_0_129)。

text: Asymmetrical pole tops with one insulator on one side of the pole and two on the other are found in and around San José.
NOTE: Fully asymmetrical pole tops with all insulators on one side of the pole can be found all across the country.
text_zh: 不對稱的電線桿頂部（電線桿一側有一個絕緣子，另一側有兩個）可以在聖荷西及其周邊地區找到。
注意：所有絕緣子都位於電線桿同一側的完全不對稱電線桿頂部可以在全國各地找到。

text: Pole attachments consisting of numbers made out of wires are found in central Alajuela and over the border in Heredia province.
text_zh: 由鐵絲組成的數字電線桿附件可以在阿拉胡埃拉中部以及埃雷迪亞省的省界對面找到。

text: **White pole plates** with black lettering are specific to the Greater Metropolitan Area. They are usually attached to the pole using metal bands, although these may sometimes be [missing](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QbxrouQ556tLVWo29).
text_zh: 帶有黑色字體的**白色桿牌**是大都會區（Greater Metropolitan Area）特有的。它們通常用金屬帶固定在電線桿上，儘管這些金屬帶有時可能會[缺失](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QbxrouQ556tLVWo29)。

text: Usually blue lettering forming a P-XXXXX code with or without the accompanying white background can be found in western Cartago province.
text_zh: 通常形成 P-XXXXX 代碼的藍色字體（帶有或不帶有相應的白色背景）可以在卡塔戈省西部找到。

text: Small black stickers with a **QR code** on the bottom can be seen around Corralillo, south of San José.
text_zh: 在聖荷西南方的科拉利略周邊，可以看到底部帶有 **QR code** 的小型黑色貼紙。

text: Yellow pole paint that is** tall** and has **3 sections** with numbers is mainly found in Puntarenas and southern Alajuela provinces.
text_zh: **高**且帶有**數字的 3 個區段**的黃色電線桿漆主要在蓬塔雷納斯省和阿拉胡埃拉省南部找到。

text: Yellow pole paint that is **shorter **and contains all the numbers **without dividing lines** is mainly found in Guanacaste and northwestern Alajuela provinces.
text_zh: **較短**且包含所有數字而**沒有分隔線**的黃色電線桿漆主要在瓜納卡斯特省和阿拉胡埃拉省西北部找到。

text: Yellow pole paint divided into** 2 sections** with** horizontal characters** at the **bottom **are almost unique to southern Alajuela province.
NOTE: You can find 2 sectioned yellow pole paint without the horizontal characters at the bottom almost everywhere in Costa Rica.
text_zh: 分成** 2 個區段**且底部帶有**水平字元**的黃色電線桿漆幾乎是阿拉胡埃拉省南部的特有標誌。
注意：你幾乎可以在哥斯大黎加的任何地方找到底部沒有水平字元的 2 區段黃色電線桿漆。

text: These black pole stickers with **yellow lettering**, located near the bottom of the pole, are limited to western Guanacaste province and the Nicoya peninsula.
text_zh: 這些帶有**黃色字體**、位於電線桿底部的黑色電線桿貼紙，僅限於瓜納卡斯特省西部和尼科亞半島（Nicoya peninsula）。

text: Croatian utility poles are cylindrical and made of concrete or wood, often with **alternating hooks **on the [wooden poles](https://goo.gl/maps/tudAitHkDfNSgbQu5) (somewhat similar to Latvian poles).
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞的電線桿是圓柱形的，由混凝土或木頭製成，[木製電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/tudAitHkDfNSgbQu5)上通常帶有**交替的鉤子**（有點類似拉脫維亞的電線桿）。

text: Traffic lights in Rijeka are held up by **long blue poles** that extend out over the road. These are exclusive to the city.
text_zh: 里耶卡的紅綠燈是由**延伸到道路上方的長藍色桿子**支撐的。這些是該城市特有的。

text: Wooden poles with **three horizontal**, **alternating** insulators are common.
NOTE: These poletops can also be found in Brazil, South Africa, and Eswatini.
text_zh: 帶有**三個水平**且**交替**絕緣體的木製電線桿很常見。
注意：這種電桿頂端也可以在巴西、南非和史瓦帝尼找到。

text: Utility poles are primarily **wooden**, typically quite **tall** and have a distinctly dark brown colour.
NOTE: All of these features are shared with Greek utility poles.
text_zh: 電線桿主要是**木製**的，通常相當**高**，且具有明顯的深棕色。
注意：所有這些特徵都與希臘的電線桿相同。

text: Poles commonly have one of three poletops. The first consists of a **crossbar** with** zero** or **three insulators** on top. The second consists of [five insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ufHrL368mHZ8aufFA) attached directly to the side of the pole. And the third one consists of a metal frame **shaped vaguely like a harp**.
NOTE: These are also commonly found in Greece. The symmetrical poletop with three insulators is specific to Cyprus.
text_zh: 電線桿通常有三種頂端造型。第一種由一個**橫木**組成，上方有**零個**或**三個絕緣子**。第二種由[五個絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ufHrL368mHZ8aufFA)直接固定在電線桿側面組成。第三種則是由一個**形狀有點像豎琴**的金屬框架組成。
注意：這些在希臘也很常見。具有三個絕緣子的對稱電線桿頂端則是賽普勒斯特有的。

text: Czechia and Slovakia most commonly use wide, round concrete poles, which are quite often attached **in pairs**.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克最常使用寬而圓的混凝土電線桿，通常**成對**安裝。

text: Czech and Slovak pole tops typically feature **short metal bars **that hold the insulators.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克的電線桿頂部通常具有**用於固定絕緣體的短金屬桿**。

text: Two support bars holding up the metal bar on pole tops, resembling an upside down **triangle**, can sometimes be found in Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: This is also found in Germany, Albania, Serbia and Romania.
text_zh: 支撐電線桿頂部金屬桿的兩根支撐桿，形似倒立的**三角形**，有時可以在捷克和斯洛伐克找到。
注意：這在德國、阿爾巴尼亞、塞爾維亞和羅馬尼亞也能找到。

text: You may also see concrete poles with trident poletops, with two arms angled upwards. The [number of insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ecRxoNT36Ew4z9d46) and [other details](https://maps.app.goo.gl/51XyjoqQ3NUSY49j9) will vary, however the general shape will be the same. Out of the pole tops listed, these are the least common, but unique to the two countries.
text_zh: 你可能也會看到帶有三叉電線桿頂的混凝土電線桿，有兩個朝上傾斜的臂。[絕緣體數量](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ecRxoNT36Ew4z9d46)和[其他細節](https://maps.app.goo.gl/51XyjoqQ3NUSY49j9)會有所不同，但大致形狀會是一樣的。在所列出的電線桿頂中，這些最不常見，但卻是這兩個國家特有的。

text: Stripy gas and water poles reminiscent of snow poles can often be found next to the road.
NOTE: Dozens of poles of various utilities all over Europe use stripy patterns. Consider the location of the pole, as well as other clues before making a guess.
text_zh: 道路旁經常可以找到讓人聯想到雪桿的有條紋瓦斯桿和水管桿。
注意：歐洲各地許多不同公用事業的電線桿都使用條紋圖案。在進行猜測之前，請考慮電線桿的位置以及其他線索。

text: Houses with thick, dark **wooden poles** supporting the upper floors are common in the northernmost parts of the country.
text_zh: 用粗而黑暗的**木柱**支撐上層樓的房屋在該國最北部地區很常見。

text: Bus stop signs in Denmark are **black and yellow**. A small sign is attached to the top of the pole, with the bus schedule underneath. Additionally, you may see this older [**blue and white**](https://goo.gl/maps/fRjTDJetFmcvkqtt6)** **version.
text_zh: 丹麥的公車站牌是**黑黃相間**的。桿子頂端附有一個小牌子，下方則是公車時刻表。此外，你可能會看到這個較舊的[**藍白**](https://goo.gl/maps/fRjTDJetFmcvkqtt6)** **版本。

text: Standard street level **utility poles are rare** in Denmark. Most of the electricity infrastructure you will find in the countryside are large, towering [overhead power lines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overhead_power_line), often near highways.
text_zh: 標準的街道路面**電線桿在丹麥很罕見**。你在鄉間能找到的大多數電力基礎設施都是大型、高聳的[架空電線](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overhead_power_line)，通常位於高速公路附近。

text: Most electricity poles are **square and concrete**, with a reverse “L” shape at the top. Less commonly, round or octagonal poles are used.
NOTE: Within the Americas, only the Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico and Uruguay use square poles.
text_zh: 大多數電線桿是**方形且為混凝土製**，頂端呈倒「L」形。較少見的情況是使用圓形或八角形電線桿。
注意：在美洲內部，只有多明尼加共和國、波多黎各和烏拉圭使用方形電線桿。

text: **Yellow traffic light poles** are typically found in the city of Santiago de los Caballeros.
NOTE: This only applies to traffic light poles - yellow signposts are common in both cities.
text_zh: **黃色紅綠燈桿**通常位於聖地牙哥市。
注意：這僅適用於紅綠燈桿——黃色路標柱在兩座城市都很常見。

text: These **black-and-purple **pole markings are only found on poles in the Santo Domingo area.
text_zh: 這些**黑紫相間**的電線桿標記僅見於聖多明哥地區的電線桿。

text: Most poles in Ecuador are [round](https://goo.gl/maps/8mA5mVbq65jxoxuB9) and made of concrete. These poles are fairly generic and not all that useful to identify the country.

However, sometimes you will see another, more useful type of concrete pole: the **ladder pole**. It has a lot of small indents – resembling the steps of a ladder. Within Latin America, these poles are more or less unique to Ecuador.
NOTE: Brazilian waffle poles also have indents, but only a couple – as opposed to the large amount of indents that Ecuadorian ladder poles have.
text_zh: 厄瓜多的絕大多數電線桿都是[圓形](https://goo.gl/maps/8mA5mVbq65jxoxuB9)且為混凝土製。這些電線桿相當通俗，對辨識該國沒有太大用處。
然而， parfois 你會看到另一種更有用的混凝土電線桿：**梯形電線桿**。它有很多小凹痕——類似梯子的階梯。在拉丁美洲內，這些電線桿或多或少是厄瓜多特有的。
注意：巴西的格子電線桿也有凹痕，但只有幾個——與厄瓜多梯形電線桿的大量凹痕形成對比。

text: Electricity poles with **oval, see-through holes** are most common in Loja province. They are occasionally found in neighbouring provinces.
text_zh: 帶有**橢圓形透光孔**的電線桿在洛哈省（Loja）最為常見。鄰近省份偶爾也能見到。

text: Estonia uses a variety of different poles and poletops. Of the three Baltic countries, it has the least consistent utility poles.
**Round wooden** poles are the most common, sometimes with diagonal supports.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞使用各種不同的電線桿與桿頂。在三個波羅的海國家中，它的電線桿一致性最低。
**圓木桿**最為常見，有時帶有斜向支撐。

text: You can additionally find a fair amount of **square concrete** poles, often also with diagonal supports. These are similar to those found in Lithuania.
text_zh: 你另外可以找到相當數量的**方形混凝土**桿，通常也帶有斜向支撐。這些類似於立陶宛常見的電線桿。

text: **Trident pole tops** are somewhat common: This pole top features one insulator on top, and two to the side.
text_zh: **三叉桿頂**相當常見：這種桿頂特色在於上方有一個絕緣體，兩側各有一個。

text: Most wooden poles have a small **metal cap on top**, similar to those found in the Nordic countries.
NOTE: Alongside the Nordic countries of Sweden, Finland and Norway, these caps can also sometimes be found in Latvia.
text_zh: 多數木桿**頂端都有一個金屬小帽**，類似於北歐國家常見的款式。
注意：除了瑞典、芬蘭和挪威等北歐國家外，這些金屬帽有時也會出現在拉脫維亞。

text: Poles in Eswatini are made of **dark brown wood** and follow a simple design. The insulators are mostly mounted on the side.
NOTE: In Southern Africa, three insulators on the pole are more commonly found in Eswatini.
text_zh: 史瓦帝尼的電線桿由**深棕色木頭**製成，設計簡單。絕緣子大多安裝在側邊。
NOTE: 在南部非洲，電線桿上有三個絕緣子的情況在史瓦帝尼更為常見。

text: In Finland, it is common to find **orange snow poles** with a thin white band near the top.

NOTE: These are also found commonly in Norway and Sweden, but with a much [wider white band](https://i.imgur.com/R8PSzB4.png?1), lower down on the pole. They can also have multiple white bands, while Finnish snow poles usually have just one band.
text_zh: 在芬蘭，很常見到頂部附近帶有細白色條紋的**橘色雪樁**。
注意：這些在挪威和瑞典也很常見，但電線桿上有著[寬得多的白色帶子](https://i.imgur.com/R8PSzB4.png?1)，且位置較低。它們也可能有多條白色帶子，而芬蘭的雪標桿通常只有一條帶子。

text: Finland primarily uses **wooden utility poles**. Most of them tend to have a simple design, but they can have a variety of poletops. Poles often have a street light attached to them.
NOTE: In Northern Europe, wooden poles are also common in Sweden, Norway, and Estonia.
text_zh: 芬蘭主要使用**木製電線桿**。它們大多數設計簡單，但桿頂可能有多種變化。電線桿上通常會附掛路燈。
注意：在北歐地區，木製電線桿在瑞典、挪威和愛沙尼亞也很常見。

text: Lamps attached to wooden poles in Finland are normally mounted to the **top **of the pole with a **double bolting**.

NOTE: Within Scandinavia, [Sweden](https://maps.app.goo.gl/B38WAHnBB6minmXg9) also uses double bolting. However, in Sweden the lamps are mounted further down and the lamp arms are usually not straight.
text_zh: 芬蘭木製電線桿上的路燈通常透過**雙螺栓**固定在電線桿的**頂端**。
註記：斯堪的納維亞境內，[瑞典](https://maps.app.goo.gl/B38WAHnBB6minmXg9)也使用雙螺栓。不過，在瑞典燈具安裝得較低，且燈桿通常不是直的。

text: Snow poles which have **2 long reflectors** can be found on bigger roads in Lapland.
NOTE: They can only be found in coverage from 2023 onward.
text_zh: 在拉普蘭的大型道路上可以找到帶有 **2 個長反光片**的雪樁。
註記：它們只能在 2023 年及之後的街景中找到。

text: Concrete poles with step-like indents are common in France. They are referred to as **ladder** or **waffle poles** by the community.
NOTE: They are also common in Spain.
text_zh: 帶有階梯狀凹槽的混凝土電線桿在法國很常見。社群通常稱之為**梯形**或**鬆餅電線桿**。
註：它們在西班牙也很常見。

text: Wooden poles and thin [octagonal metal poles](https://goo.gl/maps/HQZMGmGXLKRX2s7y6) are very common in rural areas and small towns.
text_zh: 木製電線桿和細長的[八角形金屬電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/HQZMGmGXLKRX2s7y6)在鄉村地區和小城鎮非常常見。

text: Small** blue **rectangular markings on** utility poles** are unique to France. They are often referred to as ‘stickers’ by the community, but are actually small plates.
You will find these plates on almost all wooden and metallic poles, but not as often on ladder poles.
text_zh: 電線桿上帶有**藍色**小**長方形標記**是法國特有的。社群經常稱之為「貼紙」，但實際上是小金屬牌。
你幾乎會在所有木製和金屬電線桿上找到這些牌子，但在梯形電線桿上比較少見。

text: Diamond shaped pole tops with three wires are commonly called “French poletops” within the community. They are most frequently found on top of ladder poles.
NOTE: Within Europe, “French poletops” in conjunction with ladder poles are also common in Spain.
text_zh: 頂端呈菱形且帶有三條電線的電線桿頂部在社群中通常被稱為「法國電線桿頂」。它們最常出現在梯形電線桿的頂端。
註：在歐洲範圍內，結合了梯形電線桿的「法國電線桿頂」在西班牙也很常見。

text: Some variations of the French pole tops have the insulators on top. These variations may resemble an arrowhead and are unique to France.
text_zh: 某些法國電線桿頂的變體將絕緣子設在頂部。這些變體可能看起來像箭頭，且是法國特有的。

text: Most wooden poles in Germany will feature a rectangular** white sticker**.
text_zh: 德國大多數的木造電線桿上都有長方形的**白色貼紙**。

text: Germany has a wide variety of different poles and pole tops. The most common pole tops being the [horizontal bar with uneven hanging insulators](https://goo.gl/maps/wkQ8ZgBCxShM7vyo6), [Triangle pole top](https://goo.gl/maps/g6rN1vXFzec8cEt8A), and all kinds of [T-shaped pole tops](https://goo.gl/maps/3efen5ZJh2iaVUvi7), which can have varying insulator setups.
text_zh: 德國有各種不同的電線桿與桿頂。最常見的桿頂為[帶有不均勻懸掛絕緣子的水平橫桿](https://goo.gl/maps/wkQ8ZgBCxShM7vyo6)、[三角形桿頂](https://goo.gl/maps/g6rN1vXFzec8cEt8A)，以及各種[T 型桿頂](https://goo.gl/maps/3efen5ZJh2iaVUvi7)，這些桿頂可能配有不同的絕緣子配置。

text: These **round concrete poles** are almost unique to former East Germany.
text_zh: 這些**圓形混凝土電線桿**幾乎是前東德地區所特有的。

text: These **trident-like** pole tops can be found in Bavaria, Saxony-Anhalt, and Baden-Württemberg.
text_zh: 這些**三叉戟狀**的電線桿頂部可以在巴伐利亞、薩克森-安哈特和巴登-符騰堡找到。

text: **Triangle** pole tops similar to the ones in Czechia and Slovakia are common in Western Germany.
NOTE: There may be some exceptions outside the highlighted areas.
text_zh: 類似捷克和斯洛伐克風格的**三角形**電線桿頂部在西德很常見。
註記：在突顯區域之外可能有一些例外。

text: These pole tops where the **middle** of the horizontal bar is **thicker** can be found in all of former East Germany.
text_zh: 這些水平橫桿**中間較粗**的電線桿頂部可以在整個前東德地區找到。

text: Pole tops which have a **curved** horizontal bar can be found in Bavaria, though they are rare.
text_zh: 具有**彎曲**水平橫桿的電線桿頂部可以在巴伐利亞找到，儘管它們很罕見。

text: Ghana typically uses **wooden **poles with **3 insulators** on a metallic crossbar.
NOTE: Kenya has a similar [pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wn9yQGnjHhFSLjG37).
text_zh: 迦納通常使用金屬橫樑上有 **3 個絕緣體**的**木製**電線桿。
註：肯亞也有類似的[電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wn9yQGnjHhFSLjG37)。

text: Greek utility poles are primarily **wooden**, and often have a distinctly **dark brown** colour. They will often be noticeably taller than in other countries.
text_zh: 希臘的電線桿主要是**木製**的，通常帶有明顯的**深棕色**。它們通常會比其他國家的電線桿明顯來得高。

text: These distinctive poletops, which have a metal frame shaped vaguely like a **harp**.
NOTE: They are unique to Greece and Cyprus.
text_zh: 這些獨特的電線桿頂部，具有一個金屬框架，形狀隱約像一個**豎琴**。
註：它們是希臘和賽普勒斯特有的。

text: Many poles in Greece will have **five vertical insulators**. They can either be attached to the pole or the metal frames from the previous tip.
text_zh: 希臘的許多電線桿都有**五個垂直絕緣體**。它們可以附加在電線桿上，或是附加在前一個提示中所述的金屬框架上。

text: This type of small lamp, attached to the side of poles with a **round shade** above the light bulb.

NOTE: You can also find them in [North Macedonia](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.0299962,21.3274281,3a,26.3y,154.39h,135.54t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sU2VaxXf6zLbEjBwWs3ffLQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) and [Serbia](https://goo.gl/maps/VbPpwagrgE3j4Y5r9).
text_zh: 這種類型的小型燈具，附在電線桿側邊，燈泡上方帶有**圓形燈罩**。

註：你也可以在[北馬其頓](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.0299962,21.3274281,3a,26.3y,154.39h,135.54t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sU2VaxXf6zLbEjBwWs3ffLQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)和[塞爾維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/VbPpwagrgE3j4Y5r9)找到它們。

text: Poles on Guam are almost always **concrete** and commonly very thick.
NOTE: Northern Mariana Islands typically have wooden poles.
text_zh: 關島的電線桿幾乎都是**水泥**製的，且通常非常粗。
注意：北馬利安納群島通常使用木製電線桿。

text: In Guatemala you will very commonly see poles painted with either **pink**, **green** or a combination of the two.
text_zh: 在瓜地馬拉，你經常會看到漆成**粉紅色**、**綠色**或這兩種顏色組合的電線桿。

text: **Completely green utility poles** are primarily found in the southeast of the country, but also on a road in the further north in the east and on a small stretch of road around Melchor de Mencos, near the end of the coverage in the far northeast.
These poles also feature small [pole plates](https://goo.gl/maps/sw6JyNjNerwDncwx8), which can further narrow down the road. This will be further explained in the next tip.
text_zh: **完全綠色的電線桿**主要發現在該國東南部，但也出現在東部更北的一條道路上，以及極東北端覆蓋範圍快結束時、梅爾喬德門科斯（Melchor de Mencos）周邊的一小段道路上。
這些電線桿還具有小型[桿牌](https://goo.gl/maps/sw6JyNjNerwDncwx8)，可以進一步縮小道路範圍。這將在下一個技巧中進一步解釋。

text: Most green utility poles contain a **white pole plate**, for which the **top two characters** will determine which road you are on. These roads and their corresponding characters are shown in this infographic.
text_zh: 大多數綠色電線桿都包含一個**白色桿牌**，其**前兩個字元**將決定你身處哪條道路。這些道路及其對應的字元顯示在此資訊圖表中。

text: These white rectangular stickers that have the word **‘electricista’** written on them are unique to Guatemala City.
text_zh: 這些寫有**「electricista」**字樣的白色長方形貼紙是瓜地馬拉市特有的。

text: Thick **yellow** bands can sometimes be seen on poles in Hawaii.
NOTE: Make sure not to confuse this with the 3 stripes found on Californian poles.
text_zh: 夏威夷的電線桿上有時可以看到厚重的**黃色**帶子。
注意：確保不要將此與加州電線桿上發現的 3 條條紋混淆。

text: Utility poles will never be seen in urban rounds, however you might see **cylindrical wooden** poles in rural areas. The poles can be single or double, with electricity counters or transformers attached to them.
text_zh: 在市區路段絕對看不到電線桿，但在鄉村地區你可能會看到**圓柱形木造**電線桿。這些電線桿可能是單根或雙根，上面裝有電錶或變壓器。

text: The most common type of utility pole in Hungary is a **concrete holey pole**, with relatively thin holes going all the way down to the ground. Wooden poles are also somewhat common.

NOTE: In eastern Europe, Poland and Romania also commonly use holey poles. [Polish holey poles](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.9926761,18.7114721,3a,55.1y,130.81h,98.23t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sHtPKStzKxeiHUY1s-iNu-w!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) typically do not have holes down by the ground, and tend to be relatively thin. [Romanian holey poles](https://goo.gl/maps/QyJwGvUuzdnJLVBv5) normally either have much wider, or much taller holes.
text_zh: 匈牙利最常見的電線桿類型是**帶孔混凝土桿**，具有一路延伸到地面的相對較細的孔洞。木桿也算常見。

注意：在東歐，波蘭和羅馬尼亞也很常使用 holey pole。[波蘭的 holey pole](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.9926761,18.7114721,3a,55.1y,130.81h,98.23t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sHtPKStzKxeiHUY1s-iNu-w!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) 通常接近地面處沒有孔洞，且相對較細。[羅馬尼亞的 holey pole](https://goo.gl/maps/QyJwGvUuzdnJLVBv5) 的孔洞通常要嘛寬得多，要嘛高得多。

text: If you see a **blue** or **green** street sign shaped like an **arrow**, attached to a utility pole or street light, you are likely to be in the county of Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg.

NOTE: Blue arrow-shaped street signs can also be found in [Dunakeszi](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6290186,19.1549932,3a,29.7y,151.87h,90.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se_1iRMK0jnxi0R13E9x-8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192), north of Budapest. However, those are attached to blue sign posts.
text_zh: 如果你看到形狀像**箭頭**的**藍色**或**綠色**路標，固定在電線桿或路燈上，你很可能位於索博爾奇-薩特馬爾-貝雷格州。
注意：藍色箭頭形狀的路標也可以在布達佩斯以北的[鄧納凱施](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6290186,19.1549932,3a,29.7y,151.87h,90.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se_1iRMK0jnxi0R13E9x-8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)找到。然而，那些是固定在藍色標誌桿上的。

text: The most common Indian utility pole is a concrete square pole with a trident pole top.
Beware that many regions have their own distinct poles and poletops.
NOTE: Indian poles will almost always be made of concrete or metal. Wooden poles are extremely uncommon.
text_zh: 最常見的印度電線桿是帶有三叉電線桿頂的混凝土方柱。
請注意，許多地區都有各自獨特的電線桿和電線桿頂。
注意：印度的電線桿幾乎總是混凝土或金屬製成的。木造電線桿極為罕見。

text: **Concrete holey poles** are unique to Gujarat and the Union territory of Daman and Diu, and Dadra and Nagar Haveli.
Gujarat uses a variety of poletops, some of which can be used to identify other states. Beware that holey poles generally take precedence over poletop metas.
NOTE: They are rarely found in other states especially Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh.
text_zh: **帶孔混凝土電線桿**是古吉拉特邦以及達曼-第烏和達德拉-納加爾哈韋利聯邦屬地的特有標誌。
古吉拉特邦使用各種電線桿頂，其中有些可用來識別其他省份。請注意，孔洞電線桿通常優先於電線桿頂特徵。
注意：它們在其他省份很少見，特別是馬哈拉施特拉邦、中央邦和恰蒂斯加爾邦。

text: Poles divided in** two sections**, in a similar fashion to [Brazilian poles](https://www.google.com/maps/@-24.9571111,-53.4509436,3a,51.7y,197.35h,89.21t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5lhJHp3bn7bMpsWZg81SCA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu), are common in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
text_zh: 分為**兩部分**的電線桿，其風格類似[巴西電線桿](https://www.google.com/maps/@-24.9571111,-53.4509436,3a,51.7y,197.35h,89.21t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5lhJHp3bn7bMpsWZg81SCA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)，在安 Andhra Pradesh 邦和特倫 Telangana 邦很常見。

text: Metal poles with a **mesh pattern** are commonly found in Sikkim.
text_zh: 具有**網狀圖案**的金屬電線桿常見於錫金邦。

text: **Metal holey poles** are common in Kerala.
text_zh: **金屬孔洞電線桿**在 Kerala 邦很常見。

text: Thin **grey metal poles** are seen all over northeastern India and in the Himalayan region of [Uttarakhand](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.0147909,78.8786745,3a,62.8y,249.59h,99.19t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sSGL6A0GbRH6cTLDnW-EABw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and Himachal Pradesh. You will commonly see two of these poles in close proximity.
text_zh: 細長的**灰色金屬電線桿**常見於印度東北部各地，以及[北阿坎德邦](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.0147909,78.8786745,3a,62.8y,249.59h,99.19t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sSGL6A0GbRH6cTLDnW-EABw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)和喜馬偕爾邦的喜馬拉雅山區。你通常會看到其中兩根電線桿靠得很近。

text: Small metal poletops in the shape of a **window** are found in Punjab and Haryana.
text_zh: 形狀像**窗戶**的小型金屬電線桿頂見於旁遮普邦和哈里亞納邦。

text: In Karnataka, and sometimes in Haryana, you can find **trident poletops** on **concrete poles** where the central insulator is attached directly to the top of the pole, while the other two are attached to a horizontal crossbar positioned slightly further down. There is also a [variant](https://www.google.com/maps/@12.2009963,75.8093964,3a,15y,235.71h,103.89t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbTl5fPNbWHR5rkj6eAuIPw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) having several bars instead of one.
text_zh: 在卡納塔克邦，有時在哈里亞納邦，你可以在**混凝土電線桿**上找到**三叉電線桿頂**，其中中央絕緣體直接連接到電線桿頂部，而另外兩個則連接到位置稍微靠下的水平橫樑。也有一個[變體](https://www.google.com/maps/@12.2009963,75.8093964,3a,15y,235.71h,103.89t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbTl5fPNbWHR5rkj6eAuIPw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)有多個橫樑而不是一個。

text: In Manipur you can often find **trident poletops **on poles made entirely out of **metal**. They sometimes have small bars on the top of the trident.
text_zh: 在 Manipur 邦，你經常可以在完全由**金屬**製成的電線桿上找到**三叉電線桿頂**。它們有時在三叉頂部有小橫樑。

text: **Upside down triangle poletops** placed below the top of the pole are commonly found in Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, and less commonly in Madhya Pradesh.
text_zh: 放置在電線桿頂部下方的**倒三角形電線桿頂**常見於馬哈拉施特拉邦、恰蒂斯加爾邦，在中央邦則較少見。

text: Poles in Madhya Pradesh often have a metal bar shaped like an **upside down A** slightly below the top of the pole.
text_zh: 中央邦的電線桿通常在電線桿頂部下方有一個形狀像**倒 A 字形**的金屬橫樑。

text: A connector on the pole which looks like an upside down [trapezoid](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/67/Trapezoid_2_%28PSF%29.png) is most common in Chhattisgarh and somewhat common in Meghalaya, Tripura and Maharashtra, but can rarely be found in many other states.
NOTE: They can also be paired with Holey Poles in Gujarat and Ladder Poles in Andhra Pradesh, thus only use the trapezoid when no other pole meta is present.
text_zh: 電線桿上看起來像倒置[梯形](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/67/Trapezoid_2_%28PSF%29.png)的連接器最常見於恰蒂斯加爾邦，在 Meghalaya 邦、特里普拉邦和馬哈拉施特拉邦也相當常見，但在許多其他省份則很少見。
注意：它們也可以與古吉拉特邦的孔洞電線桿和安 Andhra Pradesh 邦的梯形電線桿搭配使用，因此只有在沒有其他電線桿特徵時才使用梯形。

text: A variety of poletops attached to the pole with two vertical bars forming a **tall and narrow rectangle** can be found in West Bengal.
text_zh: 各種透過兩根垂直橫樑連接到電線桿、形成**高而窄長方形**的電線桿頂可以在西孟加拉邦找到。

text: In West Bengal you may also find poletops containing two crossbars which are connected to each other** **with thin vertical supports on either side. The lower bar is connected on either side to the pole with diagonal supports.
text_zh: 在西孟加拉邦，你也可以找到包含兩個橫樑的電線桿頂，它們兩側都用細的垂直支撐相互連接** **。較低的橫樑兩側皆透過斜向支撐連接到電線桿。

text: In the northeast you may find poles with a combination of an **even and uneven** poletop.
text_zh: 在東北部，你可能會找到結合了**均勻與不均勻**電線桿頂的電線桿。

text: Poles with two diagonal bars forming a ‘<’ shape are common in Meghalaya and Arunachal Pradesh and occasionally found in Assam.
text_zh: 形成「<」形狀的兩根斜向橫樑電線桿常見於 Meghalaya 邦和 Arunachal Pradesh 邦，偶爾見於阿薩姆邦。

text: In Assam, Meghalaya and Mizoram you commonly see poles with **two crossbars**, each with two insulators. If there are [more than two bars](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eC7DQnwG2P1YPs9Y7), you should be in Meghalaya or Mizoram.
NOTE: They can rarely be seen in other states.
text_zh: 在阿薩姆邦、Meghalaya 邦和 Mizoram 邦，你經常會看到帶有**兩個橫樑**的電線桿，每個橫樑都有兩個絕緣體。如果有[兩個以上的橫樑](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eC7DQnwG2P1YPs9Y7)，你應該身處 Meghalaya 邦或 Mizoram 邦。
注意：它們在其他省份很少見。

text: Trident poletops with the tip of the middle bar bent at a 90° angle can be found in Assam.
text_zh: 三叉電線桿頂，其中中間橫樑的頂端以 90 度角彎曲，可以在阿薩姆邦找到。

text: Poletops with a short crossbar above a longer crossbar can be found in Goa.
text_zh: 短橫樑位於較長橫樑上方的電線桿頂可以在果阿邦找到。

text: Markings on poles and trees, consisting of one black stripe in-between two white ones, are common in Tamil Nadu.
text_zh: 電線桿和樹木上的標記由夾在兩個白條之間的一條黑條組成，這在 Tamil Nadu 邦很常見。

text: Pole paint consisting of five or more thin black and yellow stripes can be found in Delhi.
text_zh: 由五條或更多細黑黃條紋組成的電線桿漆可以在德里找到。

text: Pole paint consisting of exactly four thicker black and yellow stripes can be found in Bihar.
text_zh: 由剛好四條較粗黑黃條紋組成的電線桿漆可以在比哈爾邦找到。

text: Small **yellow pole markings** are commonly found in Kerala.
NOTE: Similar stickers can rarely be found in other states.
text_zh: 小型**黃色電線桿標記**在 Kerala 邦很常見。
注意：類似的貼紙在其他省份很少見。

text: On the Andaman and Nicobar Islands you can find these **black pole stickers**, containing several digits as well as an **arrow** in the middle.
text_zh: 在安達曼和尼古巴群島，你可以找到這些**黑色桿貼紙**，上面包含多個數字以及中間的**箭頭**。

text: Poles in Indonesia are typically round and made out of either [**steel**](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA)** **or **concrete**. Many of the steel poles are painted black, and also feature the **Indonesian flag colours on them**. The pole tops are usually either [even](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA) or [uneven](https://goo.gl/maps/jA77LfkLbiz5AbK37), depending on the region.
_You can learn more about regional poles in the region-guessing section._
text_zh: 印尼的電線桿通常是圓形的，由[**鋼**](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA)**或****混凝土**製成。許多鋼製電線桿被漆成黑色，並且還具有**印尼國旗顏色**。桿頂通常是[平整的](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA)或[不平整的](https://goo.gl/maps/jA77LfkLbiz5AbK37)，取決於地區而定。
_你可以在地區猜測章節中了解更多關於地區電線桿的資訊。_

text: Indonesia uses two types of pole tops: [**even**](https://goo.gl/maps/DBHoERAvYjR6zQbk8)** and **[**uneven**](https://goo.gl/maps/i1CUqRxZzPzgqZ9p7). This refers to the bar that holds the insulators and whether it is symmetrical to the pole itself. Knowing where even and uneven poles are most commonly found is useful for region guessing.
text_zh: 印尼使用兩種型態的電線桿頂：[**平整**](https://goo.gl/maps/DBHoERAvYjR6zQbk8)**和**[**不平整**](https://goo.gl/maps/i1CUqRxZzPzgqZ9p7)。這是指支撐絕緣體的橫桿及其相對於電線桿本身是否對稱。了解平整與不平整電線桿最常出現在哪裡，對於地區猜測很有幫助。

text: On the Lesser Sunda Islands (“Nusas”), you can find poles with an **extra long support** on the pole top. Sometimes, [two supports](https://goo.gl/maps/TqHWQVDtBYiexALq9) can be present.
text_zh: 在小巽他群島（「Nusas」）上，你可以找到電線桿頂部帶有**超長支撐**的電線桿。有時，可能會出現[兩個支撐](https://goo.gl/maps/TqHWQVDtBYiexALq9)。

text: You can find these poles with a **triangle attachment** under the horizontal bar in the following regions.
NOTE: This does not apply to [stacked poles](https://goo.gl/maps/qmeRHfBzabUpZ8uu5).
text_zh: 你可以在以下地區找到這些在橫桿下方帶有**三角形附件**的電線桿。
注意：這不適用於[疊加電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/qmeRHfBzabUpZ8uu5)。

text: Poles with an **indent** on both sides are found in West Java, Jakarta, and Banten.
text_zh: 兩側都有**凹陷**的電線桿可以在西爪哇、雅加達和萬丹找到。

text: **Trident** style pole tops are most commonly found in **Central Java** and Yogyakarta, and rarely in South and West Kalimantan, and North Sumatra and Riau.
text_zh: **三叉戟**風格的電線桿頂部最常在**中爪哇**和日惹找到，在南加里曼丹、西加里曼丹、北蘇門答臘和廖內則很罕見。

text: Pole tops in North and Central Sulawesi, and Gorontalo commonly feature an **extra attachment** right under the horizontal bar.
text_zh: 北蘇拉威西、中蘇拉威西和哥倫打洛的電線桿頂部通常在橫桿下方正中央有一個**額外的附件**。

text: These poles are almost exclusive to North Sumatra. The bar which holds the insulators is **even**, but features **uneven **insulators with one on one side and two on the other.
text_zh: 這些電線桿幾乎是北蘇門答臘特有的。支撐絕緣體的橫桿是**平坦的**，但其上的絕緣體**不平均**，一側有一個，另一側有兩個。

text: Poles with a **support shaped like the letter A** are common in Kalimantan and the Nusa islands.
NOTE: A-frame poles can exist anywhere where the electrical wires are in a bend and need extra support. Use this tip with caution.
text_zh: 具有** A 字型支撐**的電線桿常見於加里曼丹和努沙登加拉群島。
注意：A 型電線桿可能會出現在電線轉彎且需要額外支撐的任何地方。請謹慎使用此提示。

text: Poles with the **flat part of the crossbar facing away** from the pole are common in Sulawesi.
NOTE: Usually, poles in Indonesia have the flat part of the crossbar [attached](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NRULcr17wky2Wskq9) to the pole.
text_zh: 橫桿**平坦部分背對**電線桿的電線桿在蘇拉威西很常見。
注意：通常，印尼電線桿橫桿平坦的部分是[附著](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NRULcr17wky2Wskq9)在電線桿上的。

text: You can often see thin, black poles next to regular poles near the East Peninsula of Central Sulawesi. Two pieces of tape can be seen near the top of the poles, usually **light blue and green**. These can rarely be seen in northern South East Sulawesi.
text_zh: 在中蘇拉威西東半島附近，你經常可以看到常規電線桿旁有細黑的電線桿。電線桿頂部附近可以看到兩段膠帶，通常是**淺藍色和綠色**。這些在東南蘇拉威西北部很少見。

text: You can find this **rectangle **attachment on the pole tops which is mostly unique to Bali. This appears with the Lesser Sunda Island [support beam](https://goo.gl/maps/2tNeMhvSXphqn48V7) as well.
text_zh: 你可以在電線桿頂端找到這種**矩形**附件，這主要是峇里島特有的。這也會和小巽他群島的[支撐梁](https://goo.gl/maps/2tNeMhvSXphqn48V7)一同出現。

text: Pole paint with **horizontal text **on the pole is usually a good clue for Bali. It is usually **dark blue** on Bali but can be [light blue](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tfSezgbbQ1Q2yKsX8) or even [green](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DKjM3Q4WCXZhhD3y9).
text_zh: 電線桿上有**水平文字**的彩繪通常是峇里島的好線索。在峇里島通常是**深藍色**，但也可能是[淺藍色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tfSezgbbQ1Q2yKsX8)甚至[綠色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DKjM3Q4WCXZhhD3y9)。

text: **Asymmetrical poles** with **2 supports** below the bar occur mainly on Sumatra and the southern part of Sulawesi. It is not commonly seen in Kalimantan or Java.
text_zh: 橫桿下方有 **2 個支撐**的**非對稱電線桿**主要出現在蘇門答臘和蘇拉威西南部。在加里曼丹或爪哇並不常見。

text: The yellow warning stickers on utility poles can be a good way to distinguish between Ireland and the UK.
The most important difference is that UK stickers feature a [guy getting zapped](https://goo.gl/maps/WiwaLDcn6Amn4Mw59) by a lightning bolt.
The Irish stickers usually have a lightning bolt, but **lack the guy getting zapped**. They also often have an extra second rectangular sticker with a black outline, below the lightning bolt.
text_zh: 電線桿上的黃色警告貼紙是區分愛爾蘭和英國的好方法。
最重要的區別在於英國的貼紙上有一個[被閃電電擊的人](https://goo.gl/maps/WiwaLDcn6Amn4Mw59)。
愛爾蘭的貼紙通常也有閃電標誌，但**沒有被電擊的人**。它們通常還會在閃電標誌下方多出一張帶有黑色外框的長方形貼紙。

text: Both Ireland and the UK use **wooden** utility poles. Pole steps bolted on the side of the pole are very common. These pole steps are shaped like a series of thin horizontal metal rods.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭和英國都使用**木製**電線桿。桿側用螺栓固定的爬桿釘非常常見。這些爬桿釘的形狀就像一排細長的水平金屬桿。

text: Both Ireland and the UK occasionally have **metal crossbars** on their wooden poles.
NOTE: These types of crossbars are also common in Sweden and Finland.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭和英國的木製電線桿上偶爾也會有**金屬橫樑**。
注意：這種型式的橫樑在瑞典和芬蘭也很常見。

text: Utility poles commonly feature these painted **black and white striped** bottoms.
text_zh: 電線桿的底部通常漆有這種**黑白相間的條紋**。

text: Utility poles with a **mesh framework** are very common.
text_zh: 帶有**網狀結構**的電線桿非常普遍。

text: You can often find this **yellow warning sign** on poles.
text_zh: 你經常可以在電線桿上找到這個**黃色警告標誌**。

text: Poles with **blue and white** paint on the bottom are unique to Eilat.
text_zh: 底部有**藍白**相間漆料的電線桿是埃ilat（Eilat）特有的。

text: Unlike most Mediterranean countries, Italy features a lot of **round concrete poles**.
text_zh: 與大多數地中海國家不同，義大利有許多**圓形水泥電線桿**。

text: Wooden poles in Italy will commonly feature a small **white pole sticker**.
text_zh: 義大利的木製電線桿通常會帶有一個小型的**白色電線桿貼紙**。

text: The most common pole tops in Italy are **concrete trident pole tops**.
There are several possible configurations of insulators.The two shown in the image are the most common ones.
text_zh: 義大利最常見的電線桿頂端是**水泥三叉戟電線桿頂**。
絕緣體有多種可能的配置。圖片中顯示的兩種是最常見的。

text: Japan mostly uses these **round concrete** poles, which have these screw-like extensions. Other information can often be found on or attached to the pole including:
- Electrical plates.
- Guy-wires.
- Pole reflectors.
Therefore, they are a key asset in region guessing Japan.
_You can learn more about plates, reflectors, and guy-wires in the region guessing section._
text_zh: 日本多半使用這種**圓形混凝土**電線桿，上面帶有螺旋狀的突出構造。桿身上或附掛的資訊還包括：
- 電力標牌。
- 支撐拉線。
- 桿身反光標。
因此電線桿是判讀日本地區歸屬的關鍵依據。
_標牌、反光標與拉線的細節，可參考「都道府縣專屬線索」那一節。_

text: You can find a variety of pole reflectors in Japan. They are typically short and **do not **touch the ground. Common patterns found all across Japan include:
- Yellow [vertical stripes](https://goo.gl/maps/7BqmnkTQC1MVKsfy7).
- Yellow [diagonal stripes](https://goo.gl/maps/y7e5UtxMuFbPtM2LA).
- Vertical or diagonal [white stripes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9oGeT8mpLgDfZjYK7).

NOTE: The [Taiwanese variant](https://goo.gl/maps/t6yb5Q4LZtRinPRQ7) has diagonal stripes that reach the ground. The [South Korean ones](https://goo.gl/maps/pcSbJznpLXenKtWX9) have diagonal, thicker stripes.
_You can learn more about the different regional reflectors in the region guessing section._
text_zh: 日本的桿身反光標樣式相當多，共通點是長度短、**不會**延伸到地面。全國常見的樣式有：
- 黃色[直條紋](https://goo.gl/maps/7BqmnkTQC1MVKsfy7)。
- 黃色[斜條紋](https://goo.gl/maps/y7e5UtxMuFbPtM2LA)。
- 直向或斜向的[白色條紋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9oGeT8mpLgDfZjYK7)。
註：[台灣版本](https://goo.gl/maps/t6yb5Q4LZtRinPRQ7)的斜紋會一路延伸到地面；[南韓的](https://goo.gl/maps/pcSbJznpLXenKtWX9)則是較粗的斜紋。
_各地區反光標的差異，可參考「都道府縣專屬線索」那一節。_

text: Every region in Japan features a **distinct plate** on their utility poles.
text_zh: 日本每個地方的電線桿都有**各自不同的標牌**。

text: The **pole reflector pads** vary by region in Japan. But generic designs can be found nationwide.
text_zh: **桿身反光板**的樣式因地方而異，不過通用款式全國都有。

text: Most regions in Japan have unique **guy wires**.
NOTE: Only the most consistent ones are on this map.
text_zh: 日本多數地方的**支撐拉線**都有各自的特徵。
註：這張圖只收錄樣式最穩定的那些。

text: You may sometimes find an **orange arrow** located above the top most pole plate in Chugoku.
text_zh: 在中國地方，有時會看到電線桿最上方標牌上面有一個**橘色箭頭**。

text: These **orange and black bands **wrapped around poles can often be found in Shikoku.
text_zh: 這種纏繞在電線桿上的**橘黑相間環帶**在四國很常見。

text: These attachments with an approximately **120-degree angle **can commonly be found on poles in Kansai.
NOTE: Sometimes there is no angle, and instead just an [angled downward attachment](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LM3HD3nFCYj27xMUA).
text_zh: 這種夾角約 **120 度**的支架常見於關西的電線桿。
註：有時沒有夾角，而是單純一根[向下傾斜的支架](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LM3HD3nFCYj27xMUA)。

text: These smaller attachments with a **90-degree angle **can commonly be found on poles in Shikoku.
text_zh: 這種較小、夾角 **90 度**的支架常見於四國的電線桿。

text: The electrical poles in Hokkaido either have this [**plus-shaped bar**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vxrc8aYqGXDnmM5HA) attached to the **side** of the pole, or one transformer mounted on [**two bars**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ySYEqmRFjMEMEwhc7).
However, if there is more than one transformer, they will often be mounted on the sides of a **square**.
NOTE: While the Kanto transformer may also be mounted on two bars, Hokkaido will never have a wooden plate.
text_zh: 北海道的電線桿要嘛在桿身**側面**裝有這種[**十字形橫桿**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vxrc8aYqGXDnmM5HA)，要嘛是單一變壓器架在[**兩根橫桿**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ySYEqmRFjMEMEwhc7)上。
不過若變壓器超過一台，通常會裝在一個**方框**的各邊上。
註：關東的變壓器也可能架在兩根橫桿上，但北海道絕對不會出現木製底板。

text: The transformers in Tohoku, which often have additional square holding brackets and the logo of the Tohoku Electrical Company, are sometimes mounted on a **round plate** with a **zigzag bar**.
Furthermore, you may also find transformers mounted on the **side** **of a** **square**, with a straight bar mounted on the top of the square. Rarely, you may find a square without a bar.
NOTE: While Kansai may have a square attachment as well, the bar will be mounted on the bottom rather than the top.
text_zh: 東北的變壓器常帶有額外的方形固定架與東北電力公司的標誌，有時會架在附**鋸齒狀橫桿**的**圓形底板**上。
此外也會看到變壓器裝在**方框的側邊**，方框頂端另有一根直桿。少數情況下方框上沒有橫桿。
註：關西同樣有方框支架，但橫桿是裝在下方而非上方。

text: The transformers in Kanto, which can have [three](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UyMb991t8fkqFCwZ7) or [two insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cKBTRWDiWHRFbbPw6), are often mounted on a [**wooden plate**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yF8PkEfCbKfek7FTA) and two bars, or a [round plate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7jHgmppBUEg2Po5w6) and a T-shaped bar.
NOTE: While the Hokkaido transformer may also be mounted on two bars, it will never have a wooden plate. Kanto ones can also be mounted without a wooden plate.
text_zh: 關東的變壓器可能配[三顆](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UyMb991t8fkqFCwZ7)或[兩顆礙子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cKBTRWDiWHRFbbPw6)，多半架在[**木製底板**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yF8PkEfCbKfek7FTA)加兩根橫桿上，或是[圓形底板](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7jHgmppBUEg2Po5w6)加一根 T 形桿。
註：北海道的變壓器也可能架在兩根橫桿上，但絕不會有木製底板；關東的則不一定要有木板。

text: The transformers in Hokuriku, which are attached with thin metal bars, often have these [**small “lamp” shaped insulators**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/52GKXLANS9PNefQv9). There will **never** be a bar present except for the attachment mentioned above.
NOTE: The prefecture of Niigata will have the Tohoku transformer design, as opposed to Hokuriku one.
text_zh: 北陸的變壓器以細金屬桿固定，常搭配這種[**小型「燈泡狀」礙子**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/52GKXLANS9PNefQv9)。除了上述支架之外**絕不會**有其他橫桿。
註：新潟縣用的是東北款式的變壓器，不是北陸款。

text: The transformers in Chubu, which often have painted **yellow numbers** and **black “tap” connectors**, are either attached with [**large** **triangle and horizontal bars**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HGLz9BBt5ixtvtPCA), or these [**thin metal brackets**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8kXAdcaVBaDhy2v56).
text_zh: 中部的變壓器常漆有**黃色編號**與**黑色分接頭**，固定方式是[**大型三角架加橫桿**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HGLz9BBt5ixtvtPCA)，或是這種[**細金屬托架**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8kXAdcaVBaDhy2v56)。

text: The transformers in Kansai have either a **straight **or **zigzag bar** mounted on the **bottom** of a **square**. The transformer(s) will be mounted on the sides of that same square.
While this is uncommon, the bar and transformer(s) may be mounted on a [**vertical bar**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kHToBhThugutvWjY9), rather than a square.
NOTE: While Tohoku may have a square attachment as well, the bar will be mounted on the **top** rather than the bottom.
text_zh: 關西的變壓器會在**方框下方**裝一根**直桿**或**鋸齒桿**，變壓器本身則裝在同一個方框的側邊。
少數情況下，橫桿與變壓器不是裝在方框上，而是裝在一根[**垂直桿**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kHToBhThugutvWjY9)上。
註：東北同樣有方框支架，但橫桿裝在**上方**而非下方。

text: The transformers in Chugoku, which have a **cross-shaped bar** attached in the **middle** of the pole, mounted by a **full triangle**, will have a **long horizontal **or [**short vertical**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/C47yQpCXaFeQ5sARA)** insulator(s)** at the end.
A white sticker will often be stuck to the bottom of the transformer with **red numbers**. They may also be painted on the **side**.
text_zh: 中國地方的變壓器在桿身**中段**裝有**十字形橫桿**，以**完整三角形**支撐，末端則是**長橫向**或[**短縱向**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/C47yQpCXaFeQ5sARA)**礙子**。
變壓器底部常貼有白色貼紙，上面是**紅色編號**，也可能直接漆在**側面**。

text: The transformers in Shikoku, which also have a **cross-shaped bar **attached in the **middle** of the pole, mounted by a **half triangle**, will have [**“hat shaped”** **short horizontal insulators**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kFzbZ6yh1rfAGQV88) at the end.
A white sticker will often be stuck to the bottom of the transformer with **black numbers**.
text_zh: 四國的變壓器同樣在桿身**中段**裝十字形橫桿，但以**半三角形**支撐，末端是[**「帽形」短橫向礙子**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kFzbZ6yh1rfAGQV88)。
變壓器底部常貼有白色貼紙，上面是**黑色編號**。

text: The transformers in Kyushu, which have a **straight bar** attached on the **side** of the pole with **three insulators** at the end, will have transformers mounted **180-degrees** from one another.
text_zh: 九州的變壓器在桿身**側面**裝一根**直桿**，末端有**三顆礙子**，兩台變壓器則呈 **180 度**相對配置。

text: Transformers in Okinawa, which have a **T-shaped bar** attached on the **side** of the pole, will have transformers mounted on **opposite sides** of the pole.
text_zh: 沖繩的變壓器在桿身**側面**裝 **T 形橫桿**，變壓器分裝在電線桿的**兩側相反方向**。

text: These **grey “insulator-esque” blocks**, which wires are fed through, can be found in the regions of Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku, and very rarely in Hokkaido.
text_zh: 這種讓電線穿過的**灰色類礙子方塊**，可見於中部、關西、中國、四國，北海道則極為罕見。

text: This pole top, with **four thicker bars** and a **circle** **piece** at the top, is common in the Chubu region.
text_zh: 這種桿頂有**四根較粗的桿件**與頂端一個**圓形部件**，常見於中部地方。

text: This pole top, with **two sides filled in** and shaped like a **tent**, is common in the Hokuriku region.
text_zh: 這種桿頂**兩側封起來**、外形像**帳篷**，常見於北陸地方。

text: This pole top, with **four thin, skinny bars**, is common in the Chugoku region.
text_zh: 這種桿頂有**四根細長桿件**，常見於中國地方。

text: This tuning fork pole top, with a **long top bar** that sticks out each end and **horizontal bar(s) **below, is found the majority of the time in the Kanto region.
text_zh: 這種音叉形桿頂，**頂桿較長**、兩端突出，下方另有**橫桿**，大多出現在關東地方。

text: This tuning fork pole top, with a **short top bar **and **horizontal bar** below, is found the majority of the time in the Chubu region.
text_zh: 這種音叉形桿頂，**頂桿較短**、下方有**橫桿**，大多出現在中部地方。

text: This tuning fork pole top, with a **thin wire** and **horizontal bar **below, is common in the Kansai region.
text_zh: 這種音叉形桿頂配有**細鋼線**與下方**橫桿**，常見於關西地方。

text: In the northern parts of the Chugoku region, you can primarily find these basic snow poles, with either a **thin** **extended**, or **thin contracted** top. They can also sometimes be found in Iwate.
text_zh: 中國地方北部主要看得到這種基本款雪桿，頂端為**細長伸出**或**細短收合**兩種。岩手縣偶爾也有。

text: Green tea plants are often grown in hedged rows. You will often see these [fans](https://goo.gl/maps/v7nZn3mNyfSH2Bp19) mounted on poles, which serve the purpose of preventing frost from falling on the plants.
The prefectures of **Shizuoka (36%)** and **Kagoshima (34%)** make up the majority of the production, with Mie (7%), Miyazaki (4%), and other prefectures (17%) making up the minority.
text_zh: 茶樹多以整齊的籬狀成排種植。旁邊常見架在桿子上的[風扇](https://goo.gl/maps/v7nZn3mNyfSH2Bp19)，用途是防止霜害落在茶樹上。
產量主要集中在**靜岡縣（36%）**與**鹿兒島縣（34%）**，其餘為三重（7%）、宮崎（4%）與其他縣份（17%）。

text: These artistically painted poles, made to resemble **birch trees**, are unique to the city of Date in Hokkaido.
text_zh: 這種彩繪成**白樺樹**外觀的電線桿，是北海道伊達市獨有的。

text: These are three common electricity poles that you will find in Jordan. Rounded concrete poles have either a **diagonal support** or consist of three horizontal **Y pole tops.** You may additionally see thin, two support metal poles with three vertical coils.
text_zh: 這些是你在約旦會找到的三種常見電線桿。圓形混凝土電線桿要麼有**斜向支撐**，要麼由三個水平的**Y形桿頂**組成。你可能還會看到帶有三個垂直線圈的細長雙支撐金屬桿。

text: A lot of Kazakh infrastructure, from pedestrian signs, poles, houses, to bollards, is very similar to what you see in Russia.
text_zh: 哈薩克的許多基礎設施，從行人標誌、電線桿、房屋到路樁，都與你在俄羅斯看到的非常相似。

text: These regions/cities have the most useful pole paints you can learn.
The descriptions will be written from top to bottom:
- West Kazakhstan Region uses red, white, and black paint.
- Atyrau Region uses blue, white, and black paint.
- Akmola region has a very thin layer of red, then white, and a thin layer of black on the bottom.
- Kostanay uses a thin layer of turqoise, and yellow.
- Petropavl has a thin layer of white, and light grey.
- Taraz has red, yellow, and black.
- Kyzylorda poles have a thin layer of yellow and red, then white.
- Kyzylorda lamp posts are white, and have turquoise on the bottom.
text_zh: 這些地區／城市有最實用、你應該學起來的電線桿漆色。
描述將由上到下依序排列：
- 西哈薩克州使用紅、白、黑三色漆。
- 阿特勞州使用藍、白、黑三色漆。
- 阿克莫拉州有一層很薄的紅色，接著是白色，底部則有一層薄薄的黑色。
- 庫斯塔奈使用薄薄的土耳其藍與黃色。
- 彼得羅巴夫爾有一層薄薄的白色與淺灰色。
- 他拉茲有紅、黃、黑三色。
- 克孜勒奧爾達的電線桿有一層薄薄的黃色和紅色，接著是白色。
- 克孜勒奧爾達的路燈桿是白色的，底部有土耳其藍。

text: These pole paints are less useful than the above hint, but still worth learning if you want to master Kazakhstan.
The descriptions will be written from top to bottom:
- Rudny has red, yellow, red on the top, with white below it.
- Kokshetau uses a few designs, but they all have light blue on the bottom, and sometimes, a thin strip, or two, of yellow on top.
- Shchuchinsk has a thin layer of red, and yellow.
- Ekibastuz has a thin layer of blue, and white
- Shymkent poles have a thin layer of yellow and red, then green.
- Kentau poles have thin layers of blue, yellow, and red, then blue and black below them.
text_zh: 這些電線桿漆色的實用性雖然不如上述線索，但如果你想精通哈薩克，仍然值得學起來。
描述將由上到下依序排列：
- ル德內（Rudny）的電線桿頂部為紅、黃、紅，下方則是白色。
- 科克舍套採用幾種不同的設計，但它們底部都是淺藍色，有時頂部還會有一或兩條細黃帶。
- 休琴斯克有一層薄薄的紅色與黃色。
- エ基巴斯圖茲有一層薄薄的藍色與白色。
- 奇姆肯特的電線桿有一層薄薄的黃色和紅色，接著是綠色。
- ケнта烏（Kentau）的電線桿有薄薄的藍、黃、紅三層，下方則是藍色與黑色。

text: Kenyan poles are either made of concrete or wood, and have an** L shaped crossbar**.
NOTE: A [similar pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tZNFYkUB6yvXdjgn6) can be found in Ghana
text_zh: 肯亞的電線桿材質為混凝土或木頭，並具有** L 形橫樑**。
注意：在迦納可以找到[類似的電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tZNFYkUB6yvXdjgn6)

text: You will often see pole markings with a **skull** and a **danger message** on it.
text_zh: 你經常會在電線桿上看到帶有**骷髏**和**危險警告訊息**的標記。

text: In Kyrgyzstan, you will often see trees and concrete poles that are **painted white** on the bottom.
text_zh: 在吉爾吉斯斯坦，你經常會看到樹木和混泥土電線桿的底部被**漆成白色**。

text: These towns east and west of Bishkek feature these **colourful poles** with yellow, green, white, and sometimes red on top.
NOTE: Sokuluk will not have the red paint on top.
text_zh: 比許凱克東西兩側的這些城鎮有著這些**彩色電桿**，頂部帶有黃色、綠色、白色，有時還有紅色。
注意：索庫魯克（Sokuluk）的頂部沒有紅漆。

text: In Talas, most poles are painted white on the bottom, and feature **red and yellow** stripes.
text_zh: 在塔拉斯（Talas），大部分電線桿底部漆成白色，並帶有**紅黃相間**的條紋。

text: This divided road north of Bishkek, that leads up to the international airport, uses unique **yellow-and-black curbs** on the median, which consists of mostly grass. Some sections have small planted trees, and poles with red-and-yellow paint on the bottom. The [horizontal section](https://goo.gl/maps/3NtVfKr8wvp3ibU48) west of the airport has a lot more trees.
text_zh: 比什凱克北部這條通往國際機場的分隔道路，在主要由草地構成的分隔島上使用了獨特的**黃黑相間緣石**。有些路段種植了小樹，還有底部漆成紅黃相間的電線桿。機場西側的[水平路段](https://goo.gl/maps/3NtVfKr8wvp3ibU48)有更多樹木。

text: Laos uses **square concrete poles**, with small pinholes on the sides in a row from top to bottom.
NOTE: Similar poles are found in Thailand, Sri Lanka, and less commonly, Cambodia.
text_zh: 寮國使用**方形混凝土電線桿**，側面從上到下有一排小針孔。
註記：泰國、斯里蘭卡以及較少見的柬埔寨也能找到類似的電線桿。

text: Latvian poles have distinctive poletops, with **hook-shaped insulators**, that are arranged in an alternating manner: left-right-left (or vice versa).
NOTE: These poletops are much more rare in the other two Baltic countries. They can however appear in some other European countries.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞電線桿具有獨特的桿頂，帶有**鉤狀絕緣子**，以交替方式排列：左-右-左（反之亦然）。
註記：這些桿頂在其他兩個波羅的海國家非常罕見。然而，它們可能會出現在某些其他歐洲國家。

text: Lebanon uses a variety of **metallic mesh poles**, which are sometimes **painted bright yellow**. Generic-looking wooden poles are common too.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩使用各種**金屬網狀電桿**，有時會被**漆成亮黃色**。看起來很普通的木製電桿也很常見。

text: Lithuanian poles are usually square and concrete, and often feature a **diagonal support beam**.
NOTE: While most common in Lithuania, these are also found from time to time in Estonia, and on rare occasions in Latvia.
text_zh: 立陶宛的電線桿通常是方形混凝土製成，且經常帶有**斜向支撐樑**。
注意：雖然在立陶宛最常見，但這些偶爾也會在愛沙尼亞找到，在拉脫維亞則非常罕見。

text: Pictured here are some typical Lithuanian poletops.
- They often have **short horizontal rods**, on which the insulators are placed.
- In some poletops, the insulators are arranged in a **trident-like shape**, with one on top, and two on each side.
Note that these poletops are not unique to Lithuania: they can also be found in the other post-Soviet countries.
text_zh: 這裡圖片展示了一些典型的立陶宛電線桿頂。
- 它們經常有**短的水平桿**，絕緣體就安裝在上面。
- 在某些電線桿頂部，絕緣體排列成**三叉戟形**，一個在上方，兩側各一個。
請注意，這些電線桿頂並非立陶宛獨有：它們也可以在其他後蘇聯國家找到。

text: **Metal pole tags** are predominantly found in the eastern part of the country.
_For more information on Lithuanian pole stickers and car metas, please see this [document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IzsTIUFuTojmx2x4KtWyxB5ZZcoPcLtiNSE2w4fSXYo/edit?tab=t.0)._
text_zh: **金屬桿標籤**主要在該國東部地區發現。
