_如需更多關於立陶宛電線桿貼紙與車請車輛線索特徵的資訊，請參閱這份 [文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IzsTIUFuTojmx2x4KtWyxB5ZZcoPcLtiNSE2w4fSXYo/edit?tab=t.0)。_

text: Poles with poletops shaped like **upside-down tridents** are the most common type of pole in Luxembourg.
In addition, you can find a variety of other poletops.
NOTE: These poles can also be commonly seen in France, Spain and Portugal.
text_zh: 頂端形狀像**倒三叉戟**的電線桿是盧森堡最常見的電線桿類型。
此外，你也可以找到各種其他樣式的電線桿頂端。
注意：這些電線桿在法國、西班牙和葡萄牙也很常見。

text: Since Madeira is an autonomous region of Portugal, you will often come across various types of Portuguese infrastructure, such as poles and chevrons.
text_zh: 由於馬德拉是葡萄牙的自治區，你經常會遇到各種葡萄牙的基礎設施，例如電線桿和轉彎標誌。

text: Electricity poles in Malaysia often have **black** or **white** stickers on them.
Sometimes you will also find red-and-white or red-and-blue stripes below the black sticker.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的電線桿通常貼有**黑色**或**白色**貼紙。
parfois 有時你也會在黑色貼紙下方發現紅白相間或紅藍相間的條紋。

text: **Black pole stickers** are most commonly found on the mainland.
NOTE: The black stickers on Borneo only exist in Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: **黑色電線桿貼紙**最常在馬來半島上找到。
NOTE: 婆羅洲上的黑色貼紙僅存在於第 4 代街景覆蓋中。

text: **White pole stickers** are only found on electricity poles on the island of Borneo, in Sarawak.
text_zh: **白色電線桿貼紙**僅在砂拉越婆羅洲島上的電線桿上發現。

text: Electricity poles on the Borneo side typically have a **2-1 insulator configuration**, and a long **diagonal wooden support**. They are exclusive to the Sarawak region of the island.
NOTE: Indonesian poles can look similar, but they are usually not made of wood, and use smaller or no diagonal supports.
text_zh: 婆羅洲側的電線桿通常具有 **2-1 絕緣子配置**，以及長條的**斜向木質支撐架**。它們是該島砂拉越地區所獨有的。
NOTE: 印尼的電線桿看起來可能很相似，但它們通常不是木製的，且使用較小或沒有斜向支撐架。

text: Thin metal poles with **two parallel **pole tops are exclusive to the Sabah region of Borneo.
text_zh: 帶有**兩個平行**桿頂的細金屬桿是婆羅洲沙巴地區所獨有的。

text: Most utility poles in Mexico are made of concrete and have an **octagonal shape**. There will often be engravings on the side.
NOTE: Octagonal poles are also common in Colombia.
text_zh: 墨西哥的大多數電線桿都是混凝土製成的，且具有**八角形形狀**。側邊通常會有雕刻。
注意：八角形電線桿在哥倫比亞也很常見。

text: **White insulators** that are shaped like acorns can be found along the coastal states of Mexico, but are by far most common in Michoacan, Colima, and Veracruz.
text_zh: 形狀像橡實的**白色絕緣子**可以在墨西哥的沿海各州找到，但以米却肯州（Michoacan）、科利馬州（Colima）和韋拉克魯斯州（Veracruz）最為常見。

text: Poles with an **asymmetric crossbar **and **double-stacked **insulators are exclusive to Mexico City, State of Mexico, Hidalgo, and Morelos.
text_zh: 具有**不對稱橫樑**和**雙層疊加**絕緣子的電線桿是墨西哥市、墨西哥州、伊達爾戈州和莫雷洛斯州所獨有的。

text: **Wooden **poles with a **lowered crossbar** are mostly found in Sinaloa and Sonora.
text_zh: 帶有**降低橫樑**的**木製**電線桿大多見於錫納羅亞州（Sinaloa）和索諾拉州（Sonora）。

text: These concrete poles with insulators **suspended below **the crossbars are unique to the Yucatan peninsula.
text_zh: 這些絕緣子**懸掛在橫樑下方**的混凝土電線桿是尤加塔半島（Yucatan peninsula）特有的。

text: The **wooden **variant of the hanging pole is found on the Baja California peninsula.
text_zh: 這種懸掛式電線桿的**木製**變體可以在下加利福尼亞半島（Baja California peninsula）找到。

text: Poles with a lowered crossbar and a **single support beam** that extend from one end of the crossbar to the pole itself can be found in Durango.
text_zh: 帶有降低橫樑且有單一**支撐樑**從橫樑一端延伸至電線桿本身的電線桿可以在杜蘭戈州（Durango）找到。

text: Poles with a** mesh body** are most commonly found in San Luis Potosi, Guanajuato, and Queretaro.
text_zh: 具有**網狀桿身**的電線桿最常出現在聖路易波托西州（San Luis Potosi）、瓜納華托州（Guanajuato）和克雷塔羅州（Queretaro）。

text: The area around **Mexicali** features flat farmland with a ridge to the west. [Washingtonia](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8)[ palms](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8) are very common and these [poles](https://goo.gl/maps/JG3LABTi1T4aSrzc9) made out of brown wood can be found.
text_zh: **墨西加利**（Mexicali）周邊地區的地形為平坦的農田，西側有一道山脊。[華盛頓棕櫚](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8)[樹](https://goo.gl/maps/Z9JhouH2WnYeJW1z8)非常普遍，並且可以找到這些由棕色木頭製成的[電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/JG3LABTi1T4aSrzc9)。

text: This lamp with a** zig-zag **bent pole arm is found in Hermosillo.
text_zh: 這種燈桿手臂呈 **之字形** 彎曲的路燈可以在埃莫西約找到。

text: The bottom half of poles in Cuernavaca are often painted **green**.
NOTE: In Generation 4, the paint usually looks faded, some to the point where it is barely visible.
text_zh: 庫埃納瓦卡的燈桿下半部通常漆成 **綠色**。
NOTE: 在 Gen 4 中，漆面通常看起來會退色，有些甚至退到幾乎看不見。

text: Poles in Chihuahua city occasionally have a strip of **white pole paint** with the street name written in black or blue text.
text_zh: Chihuahua 市的電線桿偶爾會有一段**白色電線桿漆**，上面用黑色或藍色文字寫著街道名稱。

text: Mongolian infrastructure has clear Russian influence. Wooden poles with supporting stone blocks, [white lamp posts](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.677839,113.270184,3a,64.1y,330.3h,92.79t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sAv0lfNtDl5QLj3rxCnkYzA!2e0), and [three-striped** **pedestrian crossing signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2393538,106.2025013,2a,60y,95.51h,75.52t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sXUNd4wtT71dkoiStvdsI-Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) are common to see.

Unique to Mongolia is the** **[**“ЗОГС”**](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2286946,106.2131419,2a,15y,73.91h,86.02t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sDbSJ2KjqHFeQw_Vx-Muhyg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)** stop sign**.
NOTE: Each town has unique lamp post designs, so learning them can be quite useful.
text_zh: 蒙古的基礎設施有明顯的俄羅斯影響。帶有支撐石塊的木製電線桿、[白色路燈](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.677839,113.270184,3a,64.1y,330.3h,92.79t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sAv0lfNtDl5QLj3rxCnkYzA!2e0)以及[三條紋**行人穿越道標誌**](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2393538,106.2025013,2a,60y,95.51h,75.52t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sXUNd4wtT71dkoiStvdsI-Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)都很常見。
蒙古特有的是[**「ЗОГС」**](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2286946,106.2131419,2a,15y,73.91h,86.02t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sDbSJ2KjqHFeQw_Vx-Muhyg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)**停車標誌**。
註：每個城鎮都有獨特的路燈設計，因此學習這些設計會非常有用。

text: Montenegro uses simple **round concrete** or wooden poles.
text_zh: 蒙特內哥羅使用簡單的 **圓形混凝土** 或木製電線桿。

text: Nepal typically uses square concrete poles in the flat areas, and thin metallic poles in the mountainous regions. The poletops vary, but it is often some kind of trident.

The concrete pole with a [trident pole top and triangle supports](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZpwKw2HMY3K4QkQy9) is unique to Nepal. Another common pole almost unique to Nepal is a concrete square pole with [2 vertical insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RBVJCNrtq2enZDS47) on the sides with a wide gap between them. Other poles can often appear very similar to poles in India.
text_zh: 尼泊爾在平原地區通常使用方形水泥電線桿，山區則使用細金屬桿。桿頂造型不一，但通常某種程度上類似三叉戟。
帶有[三叉戟桿頂與三角形支撐結構](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZpwKw2HMY3K4QkQy9)的水泥電線桿是尼泊爾特有的。另一種幾乎是尼泊爾獨有的常見電線桿是方形水泥桿，其兩側帶有[兩個垂直絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RBVJCNrtq2enZDS47)，且中間有很大的間距。其他電線桿看起來常與印度的電線桿非常相似。

text: Poles with a **cross** attached near the top are common in the east.
text_zh: 頂部附近附有**十字架**的電線桿在東部很常見。

text: In Kathmandu, you’ll find poles with an asymmetrical crossbar, which has a triangular attachment on top of it, as well as a support bar below it.
text_zh: 在加德滿都，你會看到電線桿帶有非對稱的橫桿，其上方有一個三角形附件，下方則有一根支撐桿。

text: The Netherlands usually **does not have any utility poles**. You might see larger power lines like the ones shown in the image, but essentially never any street-level smaller utility poles.
NOTE: Belgium does use utility poles somewhat commonly.
text_zh: 荷蘭通常**沒有任何電線桿**。你可能會看到像圖片中那樣較大型的高壓電線，但基本上完全沒有街道等級的小型電線桿。
注意：比利時確實算常見電線桿。

text: The most common pole type found in New Zealand is made of concrete and has **one long indent** which runs most of the way up the pole. Most concrete poles have small **silver **possum guards. Circular [wooden poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e4UYn9u6VSd4wSE36) can also be found, but are less common. You can also see concrete [holey poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e3uB7rNoVtCMmrzz8) in New Zealand.
text_zh: 紐西蘭最常見的電線桿類型是混凝土製，且有一道**長凹槽**延伸至電線桿的大部分長度。大多數混凝土電線桿都有小型**銀色**防鼠板。也可以找到圓形[木製電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e4UYn9u6VSd4wSE36)，但較不常見。你還可以在紐西蘭看到混凝土[孔洞電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e3uB7rNoVtCMmrzz8)。

text: Most utility poles in the Marlborough region have a long** square shaped olive-brown possum guard**. These can appear alongside the usual shorter silver possum guards.
text_zh: 馬爾堡地區的大多數電線桿都有一個長型的**方形橄欖棕色澳洲負鼠防護罩**。這些防護罩可能會與平常較短的銀色澳洲負鼠防護罩同時出現。

text: Many of the utility poles in Southland feature a **long cylindrical silver possum guard**. These are also more rarely found in western Otago.
text_zh: 南地大區的許多電線桿都有一個**長圓柱形的銀色澳洲負鼠防護罩**。這些防護罩在奧塔哥西部也比較少見。

text: **Holey poles** are found most commonly in Southland and around Auckland.
text_zh: **有洞的電線桿**最常見於南地大區和奧克蘭周邊。

text: **Square concrete poles **without the usual indent are most common in Southland, but can also be found in Otago, Taranaki and Manawatū-Whanganui.
text_zh: 沒有平常凹槽的**方形混凝土電線桿**最常見於南地大區，但也可以在奧塔哥、塔拉納基和馬納瓦圖-旺加努伊找到。

text: Poles with the middle insulator being installed on top of a **tall metal bar** are often found along the Auckland Waikato border, as well as in other parts of Waikato.
NOTE: Insulators installed on significantly [shorter vertical bars](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ka3aMJFraGfTTKWT9) are rarer and can be found all across the country.
text_zh: 中間絕緣體安裝在**高金屬桿**頂部的電線桿經常分佈在奧克蘭與懷卡托的邊界，以及懷卡托的其他地區。
注意：安裝在明顯[較短的垂直桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ka3aMJFraGfTTKWT9)上的絕緣體較為罕見，全國各地都能找到。

text: Some concrete poles in eastern Waikato and Whanganui city have **white paint** on the middle part of their wooden crossbars. This white painted crossbar can also be found in parts of western Bay of Plenty, Taranaki, Manawatū-Whanganui and eastern Wellington.
text_zh: 懷卡托東部和旺加努伊市的一些混凝土電線桿的木橫木中間部分有**白色漆**。這種漆成白色的橫木也可以在豐盛灣西部、塔拉納基、馬納瓦圖-旺加努伊和威靈頓東部的部分地區找到。

text: A **yellow tag**, similar in appearance to a cow-tag, is found on most poles in Gisborne. It is also found in a few spots on the South Island, as well as over the border in northern Hawke’s Bay.
text_zh: 一個外觀類似牛耳標的**黃色標籤**，可以在吉斯本的大多數電線桿上找到。它也可以在南島的幾個地方，以及跨越邊界進入霍克斯灣北部的地區找到。

text: A warning sticker attached to poles, which has a **yellow danger triangle between** **two white rectangles**, is found in Hawke’s Bay, from lake Taupo to lake Rotorua, in northern Waikato and south of Auckland city.
text_zh: 一個貼在電線桿上、帶有**夾在兩個白色長方形之間的黃色危險三角形**的警告貼紙，可以在霍克斯灣、從陶波湖到羅托路亞湖、懷卡托北部和奧克蘭市南部找到。

text: A medium sized **black vertical** **sticker** with **5 digits** is found in West Coast, Tasman, southern Canterbury and southern Northland.
text_zh: 一個中等大小、帶有 **5 個數字**的**黑色垂直****貼紙**可以在西岸、塔斯曼、坎特伯雷南部和紐西蘭北島北部南部找到。

text: Poles near Timaru often have a **tall rectangle of** **orange paint** on them with the text “DANGER LIVE WIRES”.
text_zh: 蒂馬魯附近的電線桿通常有一個**長方形的橘色油漆**，上面寫著「DANGER LIVE WIRES」字樣。

text: A **small black horizontal pole sticker**, with several numbers, is often found in Taranaki and Wellington. The sticker may rarely be found in parts of Manawatū-Whanganui, Waikato, and southern Hawke's Bay.
text_zh: 一個帶有多個數字的**小型黑色水平電線桿貼紙**，經常在塔拉納基和威靈頓找到。這張貼紙很少見於馬納瓦圖-旺加努伊、懷卡托和霍克斯灣南部的部分地區。

text: Similarly, a **small white horizontal pole sticker** with several numbers is found in several parts of the North Island.
NOTE: The edges of the plate must be straight, meaning they cannot be rounded. Rounded plates are seen [all across the country](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YSsMro3M3HUAyV6t7).
text_zh: 同樣地，一個帶有多個數字的**小型白色水平電線桿貼紙**可以在北島的幾個部分找到。
注意：車牌的邊緣必須是直的，這意味著它們不能是圓角的。圓角車牌[全國各地](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YSsMro3M3HUAyV6t7)都看得到。

text: The Otago peninsula east of Dunedin is recognizable from its combination of plants such as [cabbage trees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cordyline_australis), [yellow flowered bushes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ulex_europaeus), small groves of [cone-shaped pine trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/62xUM4q8p2f4hsad7), and [New Zealand flax](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phormium_tenax). Additionally, the peninsula’s poles often have [off-centre crossbars](https://maps.app.goo.gl/twAx6yizxoiVJ3rm6).
text_zh: 達尼丁以東的奧塔哥半島可以透過其植物的組合來識別，例如[菜棕](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cordyline_australis)、[黃花灌木](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ulex_europaeus)、成群的小型[圓錐形松樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/62xUM4q8p2f4hsad7)以及[紐西蘭麻](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phormium_tenax)。此外，半島上的電線桿通常有[偏心的橫木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/twAx6yizxoiVJ3rm6)。

text: Most Nigerian poles are made of concrete, have **indents **with a few **horizontal supports**, and are similar to the ones used in Brazil, but do not have holes through them.
text_zh: 多數奈及利亞的電線桿為混凝土製，帶有**凹痕**以及幾個**水平支撐架**，與巴西使用的電線桿相似，但上面沒有穿孔。

text: These **‘Greek Lamps’** on utility poles can be found in North Macedonia. They can also be found in various other countries, such as (unsurprisingly) [Greece](https://goo.gl/maps/rSnrVdTGecgndtDG9) or [Serbia](https://goo.gl/maps/VbPpwagrgE3j4Y5r9).
text_zh: 電線桿上的這些**「希臘燈具」**可以在北馬其頓找到。它們也可以在其他多個國家找到，例如（毫不意外地）[希臘](https://goo.gl/maps/rSnrVdTGecgndtDG9)或[塞爾維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/VbPpwagrgE3j4Y5r9)。

text: Each city has its own **city-specific **posters with public obituaries. They are commonly found on utility poles.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個城市都有其**城市特定的**張貼公共訃聞海報。它們通常可以在電線桿上找到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: These **long rectangular lamps** are only found in the city of Prilep.
text_zh: 這些**長條形矩形燈具**僅在普里萊普市內找到。

text: Northern Mariana Islands have **wooden poles**, frequently with a crossbar at the top.
NOTE: Guam typically has concrete poles.
text_zh: 北馬利安納群島有**木造電線桿**，頂端通常附有橫木。
注意：關島通常為混凝土電線桿。

text: Norwegian snow poles are typically orange, with a **fairly** **thin** white reflector. The reflector is normally toward the **middle** of the pole.

NOTE: [Swedish](https://www.google.se/maps/@61.9908262,14.5790953,3a,39.6y,258.06h,61.21t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1qT_52M1QOthv1f9cvsoXw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) snow poles typically have a wider reflector slightly higher up, and [Finnish](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.4814738,23.2577925,3a,15y,68.45h,69.44t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7-wUFACQ9NzGxHQu6ngnUw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) snow poles have their reflector at the very top.
text_zh: 挪威雪桿通常是橘色的，配有**相當****細**的白色反光片。反光片通常朝向電桿的**中間**。

注意：[瑞典](https://www.google.se/maps/@61.9908262,14.5790953,3a,39.6y,258.06h,61.21t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1qT_52M1QOthv1f9cvsoXw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)雪桿通常具有較寬的反光片且位置稍高，而[芬蘭](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.4814738,23.2577925,3a,15y,68.45h,69.44t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7-wUFACQ9NzGxHQu6ngnUw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)雪桿的反光片則位於最頂端。

text: It is also fairly common to find thin **wooden** snow poles with painted reflectors.
NOTE: While wooden snow poles can be found in [other Nordic countries](https://goo.gl/maps/ebwqngpn358DdBpp9), they will typically not have reflectors.
text_zh: 找到帶有塗漆反光片的細長**木製**雪桿也相當常見。
注意：雖然木製雪桿可以在[其他北歐國家](https://goo.gl/maps/ebwqngpn358DdBpp9)找到，但它們通常不會有反光片。

text: Norwegian poles are normally **wooden** and often have a small black metal cap on the top.
NOTE: This metal cap is also common in both Sweden and Finland.
text_zh: 挪威電桿通常是**木製**的，頂端常有一個黑色小金屬帽。
注意：這個金屬帽在瑞典和芬蘭也很常見。

text: Lamps attached to wooden poles in Norway are normally mounted to the pole with a **thick single bolting**.
NOTE: Sweden and Finland use [double bolting](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JHaTnCsGhkTjLMXJA).
text_zh: 在挪威，附著在木桿上的路燈通常透過**厚實的單螺栓**安裝在電桿上。
注意：瑞典和芬蘭使用[雙螺栓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JHaTnCsGhkTjLMXJA)。

text: **Black snow poles** are most commonly found between Bergen and Trondheim.
text_zh: **黑色雪桿**最常在卑爾根和特倫漢姆之間找到。

text: Small, **wide black pole plates**, with a single line of letters and digits, can be found in southeastern Norway.
text_zh: 小型、**寬版黑色桿牌**（帶有一行字母和數字）可以在挪威東南部找到。

text: Fairly large **black or red pole plates** can be found in Oslo.
text_zh: 相當大的**黑色或紅色桿牌**可以在奧斯陸找到。

text: Oman typically uses wooden poles, which have pole tops consisting of three varying designs. The first two have 3 insulators, symmetrically attached to a horizontal metal bar. The design with the [metal triangle above the wooden pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iQkF9QogKvu641R2A) is unique to Oman. The third design has the [insulators attached to the side](https://maps.app.goo.gl/V2Ziykrp3nrm2k1b7). Poles in general are more common in Oman than in the UAE or Qatar.
text_zh: 阿曼通常使用木製電線桿，其桿頂由三種不同的設計組成。前兩種有 3 個絕緣子，對稱地固定在水平金屬桿上。[木製電線桿上方有金屬三角形](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iQkF9QogKvu641R2A)的設計是阿曼特有的。第三種設計則是將[絕緣子固定在側面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/V2Ziykrp3nrm2k1b7)。整體而言，電線桿在阿曼比在阿拉伯聯合大公國或卡達更常見。

text: Panama uses a wide variety of poles, but the most common type is a **round concrete pole**, with a varying amount of insulators. Poles can also be wooden or metallic. They often have [plates](https://goo.gl/maps/5u2MsQ5wAd6cLHTt7) attached to them. [Blue](https://goo.gl/maps/wCUF3vx7iUtNgZjAA), [white](https://goo.gl/maps/4wmrWMk22ZnZtY3x5), or [red](https://goo.gl/maps/4tDyan7Qz2WnrPsX9) numbers are commonly painted on them as well.
text_zh: 巴拿馬使用各式各樣的電線桿，但最常見的類型是**圓形混凝土電線桿**，帶有數量不等的絕緣子。電線桿也可以是木製或金屬製的。它們通常附有[金屬牌](https://goo.gl/maps/5u2MsQ5wAd6cLHTt7)。[藍色](https://goo.gl/maps/wCUF3vx7iUtNgZjAA)、[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/4wmrWMk22ZnZtY3x5)或[紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/4tDyan7Qz2WnrPsX9)的數字也常被漆在上面。

text: The eastern provinces often have tall vertical plates that can be yellow or white. They are commonly attached to poles by black zip ties.

NOTE: Be careful not to mix them up with [these white vertical plates](https://goo.gl/maps/9UssGMTvSrtsLBN98), often attached by metallic zip ties. They are slightly wider than the eastern plates and always have 6 digits.
text_zh: 東部省份經常有高而垂直的車牌，可以是黃色或白色。它們通常用黑色束帶固定在電線桿上。
注意：小心不要將它們與[這些白色的垂直車牌](https://goo.gl/maps/9UssGMTvSrtsLBN98)搞混，後者通常用金屬束帶固定。它們比東部的車牌稍寬，且永遠都是 6 位數。

text: Many poles in the western provinces will have **horizontal **plates attached to them. However, if one of these is accompanied by an [eastern vertical plate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fd541FefRusFDcE37), the eastern plate takes precedence.
text_zh: 西部省份的許多電線桿上會有**水平**車牌。然而，如果其中一個車牌伴隨著[東部的垂直車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fd541FefRusFDcE37)，則以東部的車牌為優先。

text: Thin yellow plates, vertical or horizontal, with a visible black border are most common in the Colón Province.
text_zh: 帶有明顯黑色邊框的細長黃色車牌（垂直或水平），在科隆省最為常見。

text: **Yellow pole socks** can be found near the Panama Canal, around the town of Gatún.
text_zh: 在巴拿馬運河附近、加通（Gatún）城鎮周圍可以找到**黃色電桿套**。

text: The country uses a variety of poles. They are made out of either **concrete** **or** **wood**, and sometimes feature distinct horizontal concrete bars.
NOTE: Horizontal concrete bars are also found in Argentina.
text_zh: 該國使用各種電線桿。它們由**混凝土**或**木材**製成，有時帶有明顯的水平混凝土橫桿。
注意：水平混凝土橫桿也見於阿根廷。

text: Some poles in Peru have **painted bottom sections**. Most commonly they will be black or black-and-yellow.

NOTE: This pattern of pole paint is unique to Peru within South America, however, similar ones can be seen in other South American countries, such as [Colombia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mMh81AZGJ9zVyYYD7).
text_zh: 祕魯的一些電線桿有**塗漆的底部**。最常見的是黑色或黑黃相間。
注意：這種電線桿塗漆模式在南美洲的祕魯是獨一無二的，不過在其他南美洲國家也能看到類似的，例如[哥倫比亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mMh81AZGJ9zVyYYD7)。

text: Pole markings with **yellow vertical numbers** are commonly found in northern coastal Peru and Tacna.

Oftentimes, but not always, they will be accompanied by a horizontal pole marking starting with a 2 or 3 letter code corresponding to a city. For example, this horizontal sticker starts with CH for Chimbote.

NOTE: you can further divide the region based on the number of digits and the actual numbers on the pole marking. See [this document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rMBXs3_grdmPBdzT1fSfkj-MEnagQylqJnlbqOXBwkE/edit) for details.
text_zh: 帶有**黃色垂直數字**的電線桿標記常見於祕魯北部沿海地區和塔克納。
通常（但不總是），它們會伴隨著一個水平電線桿標記，以對應城市的 2 或 3 個字母代碼開頭。例如，這個水平貼紙以代表欽博托（Chimbote）的 CH 開頭。
注意：你可以根據位數和電線桿標記上的實際數字進一步劃分該地區。詳情請參閱[這份文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rMBXs3_grdmPBdzT1fSfkj-MEnagQylqJnlbqOXBwkE/edit)。

text: **Octagonal metal poles** are quite common in the Philippines.
NOTE: They can sometimes be found in [Bangladesh](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LAQNfYnDxvMB8vTbA) and [some parts of Malaysia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jCzCnTXETaJUq5Af9) as well.
text_zh: 菲律賓相當常見 **八角形金屬電桿**。
注意：這些電桿有時也可以在 [孟加拉](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LAQNfYnDxvMB8vTbA) 和 [馬來西亞部分地區](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jCzCnTXETaJUq5Af9) 找到。

text: You will often see a single insulator at the top of a vertical bar which is attached to the side of a utility pole.
text_zh: 你常會在附著於電線桿側邊的垂直桿子頂端看到單一絕緣子。

text: These black or white boxes are commonly seen on utility poles. Most of the time they feature a three letter abbreviation of the municipality you are in. The abbreviations will either have all three letters stand for the municipality, or the first two letters will abbreviate the municipality while the third letter indicates the province.
In the first image the "GMI" and "GMU" stands for the town of Gamu in the province of Isabela while the second image the "BGE" stands for the town of Bangued.
NOTE: Most towns do not have any standardised abbreviation so you might find many different abbreviations for the same place.
text_zh: 這些黑色或白色箱子經常出現在電線桿上。大多數時候，它們上面會有你所在自治市的三個字母縮寫。這些縮寫要嘛全部三個字母都代表自治市，要嘛前兩個字母代表自治市，而第三個字母代表省份。
在第一張圖片中，「GMI」和「GMU」代表伊莎貝拉省的加姆鎮（Gamu），而在第二張圖片中，「BGE」代表班格德鎮（Bangued）。
注意：大多數城鎮沒有標準化的縮寫，因此你可能會在同一個地方發現許多不同的縮寫。

text: Square concrete poles with an** indent **on both side, similar to the poles found in Chile, are mainly found north of Manila and in and around the city of Bacolod on the island of Negros.
text_zh: 兩側都有**凹槽**的正方形混凝土電線桿，類似於智利發現的電線桿，主要分佈在馬尼拉以北以及 Negros 島上的巴科洛德市內及周邊地區。

text: A poletop made up of two tall vertical metal bars having an [L-shaped cross-section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tQrN9cdrQZshGuAQ6) which are connected via several thin wires, making it resemble a ladder, is unique to Manila and the surrounding area.

NOTE: You may sometimes come across [similar looking poletops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HSfKKMtbuvh2JS9i7), with square bars instead of L-shaped ones, throughout the entire country. They will however almost never have more than two connecting wires.
text_zh: 由兩根具有[L 型橫截面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tQrN9cdrQZshGuAQ6)的高大垂直金屬桿組成、並透過幾根細電線連接而使其看起來像梯子的電線桿頂部，是馬尼拉及周邊地區特有的。
注意：你偶爾可能會在全國各地遇到[看起來相似的電線桿頂部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HSfKKMtbuvh2JS9i7)，它們使用的是方形桿而不是 L 型桿。然而，它們幾乎永遠不會有超過兩條連接線。

text: **Square metal mesh poles** are found on Mindanao, mainly on the Zamboanga peninsula.
NOTE: Most of the poles found outside of the Zamboanga peninsula are found along highways and have poletops with [three hanging insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Tjfv9YpHyA3eSqoNA).
text_zh: **方型金屬網電線桿**分佈在 Mindanao，主要在三寶顏半島。
注意：三寶顏半島以外發現的大多數電線桿都位於公路沿線，並且其電線桿頂部帶有[三個懸掛式絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Tjfv9YpHyA3eSqoNA)。

text: Poland usually has thin concrete utility poles with see-through holes. They are commonly known as “**holey poles**”. The holes often do not extend all the way to the bottom of the pole.

Sometimes, two poles are [joined together](https://goo.gl/maps/Vx3xtYdZgLvhFV1R7), or put in an [A-frame](https://goo.gl/maps/HwEYE3Fa7oYY7gfZA) shape. You can also find [round concrete poles](https://goo.gl/maps/ebKDEEhg6C8nj3ms5).
NOTE: Hungary and Romania also have holey poles, but these are wider and more bulky. In addition, the holes extend all the way to the bottom.
text_zh: 波蘭通常有帶透光孔的細混凝土電線桿。它們通常被稱為「**洞洞桿**」。這些孔洞通常不會一路延伸到電線桿底部。
有時候，兩根電線桿會[連接在一起](https://goo.gl/maps/Vx3xtYdZgLvhFV1R7)，或是擺成[A字形](https://goo.gl/maps/HwEYE3Fa7oYY7gfZA)。你也可以找到[圓形混凝土電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/ebKDEEhg6C8nj3ms5)。
注意：匈牙利和羅馬尼亞也有洞洞桿，但它們更寬、更粗壯。此外，它們的孔洞會一路延伸到底部。

text: Electricity poles with **yellow markings** are predominantly found in western and southern Poland.

_For more detailed information on Polish utility poles, including the markings and lamps discussed here, see this [document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oJxYV55KJpYkST2ZmxXHc9GaNUiOmvyzfXQg_msfvSk/)._
text_zh: 帶有**黃色標記**的電線桿主要分佈在波蘭西部和南部。
_有關波蘭電線桿的更多詳細資訊，包括此處討論的標記和燈具，請參閱此[文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oJxYV55KJpYkST2ZmxXHc9GaNUiOmvyzfXQg_msfvSk/)。_

text: **Black pole markings** are most commonly seen in the southeast of the country, as well as some areas in the north.
text_zh: **黑色電線桿標記**最常見於該國東南部，以及北部的一些地區。

text: Street lamps mounted **on top** of the pole become more common towards the northeast of the country, with some pockets in the far south.
text_zh: 安裝在電線桿**頂部**的路燈在該國東北部變得更為常見，極南部也有一些零星分佈。

text: In contrast, lamps attached to the **side** of the pole are rarely found in the northeast.
text_zh: 相比之下，安裝在電線桿**側面**的路燈在東北部很少見。

text: Concrete ladder poles, with very **tall ladder steps**, are common in Portugal. Each step often has a small [see-through hole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vDoNQJNkY2srorxc8).

NOTE: In [Spain](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.5609502,-8.1852362,3a,32.9y,335.94h,91.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sRl489cMP23rutAjdJsp5KA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) and [France](https://goo.gl/maps/cYtpBcr8fPxdawT1A) you will commonly see ladder poles with short steps.
text_zh: 混凝土梯形電線桿在葡萄牙很常見，具有非常**高的階梯**。每個階梯通常都有一個小的[透光孔](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vDoNQJNkY2srorxc8)。

NOTE: 在[西班牙](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.5609502,-8.1852362,3a,32.9y,335.94h,91.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sRl489cMP23rutAjdJsp5KA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)和[法國](https://goo.gl/maps/cYtpBcr8fPxdawT1A)，你會常見到短階梯的梯形電線桿。

text: The Serra da Estrela natural park can be recognised by the **rocky mountainous highland landscape**, often combined with yellow and black striped snow poles.
text_zh: Serra da Estrela 自然公園可以透過**多岩石的山區高原景觀**來識別，通常伴隨著黃黑相間的雪樁。

text: Qatar uses **round** poles with 3 insulators on the pole top, with the middle one being slightly higher. The crossbar also has 2 diagonal bars connecting it to the pole.
text_zh: 卡達使用**圓形**電線桿，桿頂有 3 個絕緣子，中間的稍微高一些。橫擔上也有 2 根斜桿將其與電線桿連接。

text: Being a French Department, you will see **French infrastructure**, such as [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28), [bollards](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [poles](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 身為法國的省份，你會看到**法國的基礎設施**，例如[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28)、[路樁](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)與[電線桿](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: The most common types of utility poles in Romania are **holey poles** with the holes going all the way to the bottom. The holes are typically either quite wide or quite tall.

NOTE: Poland and Hungary also both use holey poles. [Polish](https://goo.gl/maps/chLemRYUZcz7DDFL6) holey poles do not have holes near the bottom and [Hungarian](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6425626,20.0330594,3a,75y,313.1h,93.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sKeSZXDk8-kk4EYn1mVYf3Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) holey poles generally have smaller holes than in Romania.
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞最常見的電線桿類型是**帶孔電線桿**，孔洞一路延伸至底部。這些孔洞通常相當寬或相當高。

注意：波蘭和匈牙利也都有使用帶孔電線桿。[波蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/chLemRYUZcz7DDFL6)的帶孔電線桿底部附近沒有孔洞，而[匈牙利](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6425626,20.0330594,3a,75y,313.1h,93.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sKeSZXDk8-kk4EYn1mVYf3Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的帶孔電線桿孔洞通常比羅馬尼亞的小。

text: **Round concrete poles** are also quite common.
NOTE: These are very similar to poles found in Bulgaria.
text_zh: **圓形混凝土電線桿**也相當常見。
注意：這些與保加利亞發現的電線桿非常相似。

text: Trees and poles will often have **white painted bottoms**.
NOTE: This is also common in Ukraine and parts of Russia.
text_zh: 樹木和電線桿通常會有**漆成白色的底部**。
注意這在烏克蘭和俄羅斯部分地區也很常見。

text: This type of extremely **large yellow pole** sticker is specific to Romania.

Beware that [smaller stickers](https://goo.gl/maps/2Dme6waEUjKguFWWA) are also common and that both [Bulgaria](https://goo.gl/maps/TnBDLBKuq3V8JjLc9) and [Hungary](https://goo.gl/maps/dvBUfMAjvm63LBC17) can have similar ones.
NOTE: The town or city name will typically be written close to the middle of these stickers. In this case Podu Iloaiei is written.
text_zh: 這種極為**大型的黃色電線桿**貼紙是羅馬尼亞特有的。
請注意，[較小的貼紙](https://goo.gl/maps/2Dme6waEUjKguFWWA)也很常見，且[保加利亞](https://goo.gl/maps/TnBDLBKuq3V8JjLc9)和[匈牙利](https://goo.gl/maps/dvBUfMAjvm63LBC17)也可能出現類似的貼紙。
注意：城鎮名稱通常會寫在這些貼紙的中間附近。此例中寫的是 Podu Iloaiei。

text: Two support bars holding up the metal bar on pole tops, resembling an upside down triangle, can sometimes be found in Romania.
NOTE: Czechia, Slovakia, Albania and Serbia also feature this pole top.
text_zh: 支撐電線桿頂部金屬桿的兩根支撐桿，形似倒三角形，有時可以在羅馬尼亞找到。
注意：捷克、斯洛伐克、阿爾巴尼亞和塞爾維亞也有這種電線桿頂部。

text: Russia mainly uses **square concrete poles**.
NOTE: Square concrete poles can be seen in other post-Soviet countries, such as Ukraine, Lithuania, Estonia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan.
text_zh: 俄羅斯主要使用**方形混凝土電線桿**。
注意：方形混凝土電線桿也見於其他前蘇聯國家，例如烏克蘭、立陶宛、愛沙尼亞、喬治亞、哈薩克和吉爾吉斯。

text: You can often see **concrete support blocks** at the bottom of utility poles, with wooden poles often being raised above ground by the support.

NOTE: [Similar blocks](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.4300351,17.7728644,3a,32.5y,3.03h,74.13t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sQ_utNdLPQAxCA1f1l0Jgnw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) are found in several Central and Eastern European countries.
text_zh: 你經常可以在電線桿底部看到**混凝土支撐塊**，木桿通常由支撐塊高舉離地。
注意：[類似的塊狀結構](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.4300351,17.7728644,3a,32.5y,3.03h,74.13t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sQ_utNdLPQAxCA1f1l0Jgnw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)見於多個中東歐國家。

text: **Black & white-striped pole shields** are common along highways, especially in European Russia.
text_zh: **黑白相間的電線桿防撞板**在公路沿線很常見，特別是在歐洲俄羅斯。

text: These **alternating red and white** poles are mainly found in Ulyanovsk city, but also less commonly in the [greater Nizhny Novgorod area](https://goo.gl/maps/JNLBV3L6cogEaBiCA) as well as somewhat randomly elsewhere in the country.
text_zh: 這些**紅白相間**的電桿主要見於烏里揚諾夫斯克市，但也較少見於[大下諾夫哥羅德地區](https://goo.gl/maps/JNLBV3L6cogEaBiCA)，以及國內其他一些隨機的地點。

text: These **striped red and white** poles are found mostly in Saransk, but also in a few other cities in Mordovia.
text_zh: 這些**紅白條紋**的電桿主要見於薩蘭斯克，但也出現在莫爾多維亞的其他幾個城市。

text: **Yellow pole plates** attached by a **metal band** are commonly found in Tatarstan. They are found on the majority of poles, but not all.
text_zh: 透過**金屬帶**固定的**黃色電桿銘牌**在韃靼斯坦很常見。它們出現在大多數電桿上，但非全部。

text: **Extended insulator bars** on poles are notably found in southern Chelyabinsk Oblast and [eastern Orenburg Oblast](https://goo.gl/maps/ahe7wDESrVMJiZDD6), as well as [southern Kemerovo Oblast](https://goo.gl/maps/nSDobcgFvaTL8EPt5).
text_zh: 電桿上的**延長絕緣子串**顯著見於車里雅賓斯克州南部和[奧倫堡州東部](https://goo.gl/maps/ahe7wDESrVMJiZDD6)，以及[克麥羅沃州南部](https://goo.gl/maps/nSDobcgFvaTL8EPt5)。

text: Utility poles with a **mesh framework** are usually found in Petrozavodsk, but can much less commonly be found in cities like [Tolyatti](https://goo.gl/maps/QeRuT92WeXEavqv48).
text_zh: 帶有**網狀結構**的電線桿通常見於彼得羅扎伏茨克，但在[陶里亞蒂](https://goo.gl/maps/QeRuT92WeXEavqv48)等城市則較不常見。

text: These **red painted** poles are only found in Murom.
text_zh: 這些**漆成紅色的**電線桿僅能在穆羅姆找到。

text: An **angled extended insulator bar** on the pole as shown is found in Chita.
text_zh: 電線桿上如圖所示的**帶角度延伸絕緣棒**可以在赤塔找到。

text: Pedestrian signs with a **U-shaped hook** attached to a pole are unique to Chelyabinsk.
text_zh: 附有連接到電線桿的**U型鉤**的行人標誌是車里雅賓斯克特有的。

text: Lampposts along many national roads will have the road number painted in black letters. Below that, you will find the lamp number, which generally, but not always, increases the further from Kigali you get.
text_zh: 許多國道沿線的燈桿會用黑色字體漆上道路編號。在其下方可以找到燈桿編號，通常（但非絕對）距離基加利越遠，編號就越大。

text: Just like Italy, most utility poles in San Marino are **round **and made** **of **concrete. **Wooden poles are also found in the country.
text_zh: 就像義大利一樣，聖馬利諾的大多數電線桿都是**圓**的且由**混凝土****製成**。該國也能見到木製電線桿。

text: Being a former French colony, Senegal uses French infrastructure such as **bollards**, **poles**, **signs** and **road** **lines**.
text_zh: 作為前法國殖民地，塞內加爾使用法國的基礎設施，例如**路樁**、**電線桿**、**標誌**與**道路** **標線**。

text: Slovakia and Czechia most commonly use wide, round concrete poles, which are quite often attached **in pairs**.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克和捷克最常使用粗大的圓形混凝土電線桿，通常**成對**安裝。

text: Slovak and Czech poletops typically feature **short metal bars **that hold the insulators.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克和捷克的電線桿頂部通常配備**短金屬桿**來支撐絕緣子。

text: Two support bars holding up the metal bar on pole tops, resembling an upside down **triangle**, can sometimes be found in Slovakia and Czechia.
NOTE: This is also found in Germany, Albania, Serbia and Romania.
text_zh: 在斯洛伐克和捷克，有時可以發現兩根支撐桿撐起電線桿頂部的金屬桿，形似倒立的**三角形**。
注意：這在德國、阿爾巴尼亞、塞爾維亞和羅馬尼亞也能找到。

text: You may also see concrete poles with trident poletops, with two arms angled upwards. Some features, such as the [number of insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fc2r38kWnFRgtuCX6), will vary, however the general shape will be the same. Out of the pole tops listed, these are the least common, but unique to the two countries.
text_zh: 你可能也會看到配備三叉式桿頂、且有兩個向上傾斜支臂的混凝土電線桿。某些特徵（例如[絕緣子數量](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fc2r38kWnFRgtuCX6)）會有所不同，但整體形狀會是相同的。在所列出的電線桿頂部中，這些是最不常見的，但卻是這兩個國家特有的。

text: Stripy gas and water poles reminiscent of snow poles can often be found next to the road.
NOTE: Dozens of poles of various utilities all over Europe use stripy patterns. Consider the location of the pole, as well as other clues before making a guess.
text_zh: 道路旁經常可以找到讓人聯想到雪桿的有條紋瓦斯桿和水管桿。
注意：歐洲各地許多不同公用事業的電線桿都使用條紋圖案。在進行猜測之前，請考慮電線桿的位置以及其他線索。

text: It is somewhat more common to see **wooden poles**, and in turn, white concrete supports in Slovakia rather than in Czechia.
Note that because there are many variables, it may sometimes be inconsistent. Therefore, this information should preferably be used to help decide between a difficult fifty-fifty.
text_zh: 在斯洛伐克，看到**木桿**以及隨之而來的白色混凝土支撐，比在捷克稍微常見一些。
請注意，由於變數很多，有時可能會出現不一致的情況。因此，這些資訊最好用於協助在困難的五五波情況下做出決定。

text: Concrete poles in Nitra and Trnava regions commonly have** yellow circles** painted on them, usually containing a number. They are also occasionally found in adjacent regions.
NOTE: This is only the case with circles, other shapes are found [elsewhere](https://goo.gl/maps/QyZSJSBRyQfXziUD6) in the country.
text_zh: 尼特拉（Nitra）和特爾納瓦（Trnava）地區的混凝土電線桿通常畫有**黃色圓圈**，通常裡面包含一個數字。它們偶爾也會在鄰近地區被發現。
注意：這僅適用於圓圈，其他形狀可在該國[其他地方](https://goo.gl/maps/QyZSJSBRyQfXziUD6)找到。

text: Trolleybuses in Žilina use a **green-yellow-white** colour scheme. The trolley supporting electricity poles, often doubling as [lamps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nfWAtqUmKhWctMb56), are painted with matching yellow and green colours.
text_zh: 日利納（Žilina）的無軌電車採用**綠-黃-白色**配色方案。支撐無軌電車電力的電線桿（通常兼作[路燈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nfWAtqUmKhWctMb56)）塗有相匹配的黃色和綠色。

text: The most common type of pole in South Africa features 1 to 5 horizontal bars with thin white insulators that resemble rows of birds, which is why they are referred to as “**bird poles**” in the community.
NOTE: South Africa has a wide variety of other poles and pole tops. Some of these are (mostly) limited to a certain region; you can learn more about them in the region guessing section.
text_zh: 南非最常見的電線桿類型具有 1 到 5 根水平橫桿，配有細小的白色絕緣子，看起來像一排排的鳥，這也是為什麼社群中稱它們為「**鳥柱**」。
註：南非有各種各樣的其他電線桿和電線桿頂端。其中一些（大多）僅限於特定地區；你可以在地區猜測章節中了解更多關於它們的資訊。

text: Poles with 3 bars forming the letter **‘A’**, with the bottom insulators being attached at the edges of a horizontal bar, can be found almost exclusively in Western Cape, and rarely in bordering provinces.
text_zh: 具有 3 根橫桿形成**「A」**字形、且底部絕緣子連接在水平橫桿兩端的電線桿，幾乎僅能在西開普省找到，在鄰近省份則非常罕見。

text: A similar poletop can be found in Eastern Cape, however the A-shape is noticeably wider and the bottom insulators are attached directly to the ‘A’ rather than a horizontal bar.
text_zh: 東開普省也能找到類似的電線桿頂端，但 A 字形明顯較寬，且底部絕緣子是直接連接在「A」字上，而不是連接在水平橫桿上。

text: **Trident pole tops** are almost unique to KwaZulu-Natal.
text_zh: **三叉戟電線桿頂端**幾乎是夸祖魯-納塔爾省特有的。

text: Poles with **3 alternating insulators **sticking out horizontally at the top are mostly seen in the four northern provinces of Limpopo, Gauteng, North West and Mpumalanga. They can also sometimes be found in Northern Cape. In the rest of the country, these pole tops are exceedingly rare.
text_zh: 頂部有 **3 個交錯絕緣子**水平突出的電線桿，主要見於林波波省、豪滕省、西北省和普 Mpumalanga 等四個北部省份。它們有時也能在北開普省找到。在該國的其他地區，這些電線桿頂端極其罕見。

text: Poles with 2 **diagonal bars **forming a ‘<’ shape can be found mostly in the northeastern provinces, most commonly in Limpopo and North West.
text_zh: 具有 2 根形成「<」形狀的**對角線橫桿**的電線桿，主要見於東北部省份，最常見於林波波省和西北省。

text: Poles with **1 or 2 metal arms** holding up insulators are most commonly seen in Mpumalanga.
text_zh: 用來支撐絕緣子的** 1 或 2 根金屬臂**電線桿最常見於普 Mpumalanga。

text: Big **bird nests** on top of poles are commonly seen in the northern part of the Northern Cape Province.
text_zh: 北開普省北部常見到電線桿頂端有巨大的**鳥巢**。

text: Traffic lights and pedestrian crossing poles in Johannesburg are encircled by three strips of **reflective tape**.
text_zh: 約翰尼斯堡的紅綠燈和行人穿越道電桿上環繞著三條**反光膠帶**。

text: Poles or any public infrastructure will often be plastered with **dodgy adverts** for abortion services or penis enlargement pills in and around Gauteng, in particular in Johannesburg and Emalahleni.
text_zh: 在豪登省及其周邊地區（特別是在約翰尼斯堡和埃馬拉黑萊尼），電線桿或任何公共基礎設施上經常貼滿了關於墮胎服務或男性生長素的**可疑廣告**。

text: Utility poles almost always have these pole markings near the bottom, consisting of **black and yellow diagonal stripes**.
These markings look similar to the ones found in Taiwan. There are however two main differences:
- In South Korea, the stripes do not reach all the way to the bottom, whereas in Taiwan they do.
- In South Korea, the stripes are more yellow. In Taiwan, they have more of an orange tint.
text_zh: 電線桿底部附近幾乎總是有這些桿子標記，由**黑黃相間的斜條紋**組成。
這些標記看起來類似於台灣的標記。然而，兩者有兩個主要區別：
- 在南韓，條紋沒有一直延伸到最底部，而在台灣則有。
- 在南韓，條紋更偏黃。在台灣，它們帶有更多的橙色調。

text: Most poles have a tapered “**spike**” on top.
text_zh: 大多數電線桿頂部都有一個逐漸變細的「**尖刺**」。

text: Street signs will be blue, **arrow-shaped** and commonly **hanging** from a metal bar mounted to utility poles.
text_zh: 街道標誌將是藍色、**箭頭形狀**，並且通常**懸掛**在安裝在電線桿上的金屬桿上。

text: In Spain, you can find a variety of electricity poles and pole tops. In small towns and sparsely populated rural areas **concrete ladder poles** and **wooden poles** are the most common.
“Ladder” poles have indents that resemble a ladder, hence the name.
text_zh: 在西班牙，你可以找到各種電線桿和電線桿頂。在小鎮和人口稀少的農村地區，**混凝土梯形桿**和**木桿**最為常見。
「梯形」桿有類似梯子的凹痕，因而得名。

text: “**French style**” poletops are common in Spain. They are shaped like an upside down triangle, with a horizontal top bar that is curved slightly upwards. They are usually found on top of tall ladder poles or [medium sized steel poles](https://goo.gl/maps/yWPof9m7EEy7o5u97).
NOTE: As the name suggests, French poletops are also very common in France.
text_zh: 「**法式風格**」電線桿頂在西班牙很常見。它們形狀像倒三角形，頂部水平橫桿微微向上彎曲。它們通常位於高大的梯形桿或[中型鋼桿](https://goo.gl/maps/yWPof9m7EEy7o5u97)的頂部。
注意：顧名思義，法式電線桿頂在法國也非常常見。

text: Yellow snow poles with one or two reflectors are unique to Asturias. They are usually found in the south of the region.
text_zh: 帶有一或兩個反光板的黃色雪桿是阿斯圖里亞斯特有的。牠們通常出現在該地區的南部。

text: Poles with a **steel mesh** structure making **rectangular shapes** instead of the typical triangles can be found in the southern half of Spain, and are particularly common in Murcia and southern Alicante.
text_zh: 採用**鋼網**結構組成**矩形形狀**（而非典型三角形）的柱子，可在西班牙南部找到，在莫urcia和阿利坎特南部特別常見。

text: **Blue and yellow snow poles** are unique to Andalusia.
text_zh: **藍黃相間的雪桿**是安達魯西亞特有的。

text: Sri Lanka typically uses **concrete utility poles**. Two pole types are common and distinctive:
- [Square poles](https://goo.gl/maps/i36FFgx1jfjK7pf77) with small pinholes in the sides. These pinholes are limited to the top part of the pole.
- Poles with large [see-through holes](https://goo.gl/maps/UZTouXphP9iE3Wh9A) in the lower half of the pole (“holey poles“). These poles are unique to Sri Lanka.
NOTE: The square poles with small pinholes can look very similar to those found in Thailand. However, in Thailand the pinholes extend all the way to the bottom of the pole.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡通常使用 **混凝土電線桿**。兩種電線桿類型很常見且具有獨特辨識度：
- 側面帶有小針孔的 [方形電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/i36FFgx1jfjK7pf77)。這些針孔僅限於電線桿的頂部。
- 電線桿下半部帶有大型 [穿透孔](https://goo.gl/maps/UZTouXphP9iE3Wh9A) 的電線桿（「多孔電線桿」）。這些電線桿是斯里蘭卡特有的。
注意：帶有小針孔的方形電線桿看起來可能非常類似於泰國的電線桿。然而，在泰國，針孔一直延伸到電線桿底部。

text: Snow poles are typically **orange,** with a tall white reflector slightly above the middle of the pole. Some poles have a [second, thinner reflector](https://goo.gl/maps/p7anmAqGD4d4cWpU8) above the normal one.

NOTE: Finland and Norway both have similar orange snow poles. The reflector on [Finnish poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kY4315w9yyRt687A7) is usually much thinner and very close to the top. Norwegian poles typically have either [one](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rLTuiYPRgLYJeuUp7) or [two](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dBmWqWTEEVdaS6A17) slightly thinner reflectors, with one commonly being very close to the [middle](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.2671629,20.5483337,3a,15y,97.03h,80.51t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sjcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Djcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D26.576565%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 雪桿通常是**橘色**的，在桿子中段上方有一片高大的白色反光片。有些雪桿在正常反光片的上方還有[第二個較細的反光片](https://goo.gl/maps/p7anmAqGD4d4cWpU8)。

註：芬蘭和挪威都有類似的橘色雪桿。[芬蘭雪桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kY4315w9yyRt687A7)上的反光條通常細得多，且非常靠近頂端。挪威雪桿通常有一條或[兩條](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rLTuiYPRgLYJeuUp7)較細的反光條（[單條](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dBmWqWTEEVdaS6A17)的情況也很常見），其中一條通常非常靠近[中間](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.2671629,20.5483337,3a,15y,97.03h,80.51t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sjcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Djcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D26.576565%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: Swedish utility poles are usually **wooden** and can have a variety of poletops. There is commonly a small black metal cap on the very top, which is only found in Nordic countries.
NOTE: Norway and Finland also use primarily wooden poles.
text_zh: 瑞典的電線桿通常是**木製**的，且桿頂造型多變。頂端通常有一個黑色的小金屬帽，這只有在北歐國家才能找到。
注意：挪威和芬蘭也主要使用木製電線桿。

text: Lamps attached to wooden poles in Sweden are normally mounted slightly **below the** **top **of the pole with a **double bolting**.
NOTE: Within Scandinavia, [Finland](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LaC1h9f3tY7ovMHDA) also uses double bolting. However, Finland’s lamps are mounted at the top and are much straighter.
text_zh: 瑞典固定在木製電線桿上的路燈通常安裝在電線桿**頂部**的**下方**，並採用**雙螺栓**固定。
注意：在斯堪地那維亞地區，[芬蘭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LaC1h9f3tY7ovMHDA)也使用雙螺栓固定。不過，芬蘭的路燈是安裝在頂部，且筆直許多。

text: These wooden electricity markers, with a **blue** and a **white stripe** at the top, are often found near utility poles and pylons, and are not found in any other Nordic country.
text_zh: 這些頂部帶有**藍色**和**白色條紋**的木製電力標誌，經常出現在電線桿和高壓電塔附近，在其他任何北歐國家都找不到。

text: **Green snow poles** can occasionally be found in the area surrounding Umeå.
text_zh: 于默奧（Umeå）周邊地區偶爾可以找到**綠色雪桿**。

text: These **small yellow signs** advertising tree felling are commonly found on utility poles and lamp posts in the suburbs of Stockholm. While the phone code for Stockholm is usually written on the signs, it is often difficult to make out [from a distance](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vu1DKvwVwfjsGnEd9).
text_zh: 這些宣傳砍樹的**小型黃色標誌**常見於斯德哥爾摩郊區的電線桿和燈柱上。雖然斯德哥爾摩的電話區號通常寫在標誌上，但[從遠處](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vu1DKvwVwfjsGnEd9)往往很難看清。

text: If you are in a mountainous area with orange snow poles that have **two wide reflectors close together**, you are very likely to be near the Norwegian border on, or close to road E12.
text_zh: 如果你身處山區，且橙色雪樁上有**兩個靠得很近的寬反光片**，你非常有可能靠近挪威邊境，或位於 E10 道路附近。

text: The stretch of road 95 closest to the Norwegian border can be recognized by a large number of **yellow snow poles**, all having two white reflectors. The coverage can be either Generation 2 in autumn or winter, or snowy Generation 4.
text_zh: 靠近挪威邊境的 95 號公路路段可以透過大量的**黃色雪樁**來識別，所有雪樁都有兩個白色反光片。街景覆蓋可能是秋季或冬季的 Generation 2，或者是積雪的 Generation 4。

text: If you see a **mixture** of orange and yellow snow poles in a mountainous area, you should be on road E10 close to the Norwegian border.
text_zh: 如果你在山區看到橙色和黃色雪樁的**混合**，你應該是在靠近挪威邊境的 E10 公路上。

text: On top of the language, the Portuguese influence can also be seen in infrastructure, such as ladder poles and pedestrian signs with the same design as in Portugal.
text_zh: 除了語言之外，葡萄牙的影響也能在基礎設施中看到，例如與葡萄牙相同設計的階梯電線桿和行人標誌。

text: Some wooden poles are painted **blue **on the bottom. You can also read the letters **CST **on them.
text_zh: 有些木製電線桿底部漆成**藍色**。你也可以在上面讀到字母**CST**。

text: The town of Trinidade has poles with **red and white** pole paint.
text_zh: 特林達代鎮（Trinidade）的電線桿上有**紅白相間**的塗漆。

text: Poles almost always feature these **black and yellow** diagonal-striped markings that run all the way to the bottom.

NOTE: Similar markings can be seen in [South Korea](https://www.google.com/maps/@36.1050385,128.4118405,3a,18.9y,354.87h,62.54t,0.72r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfnv3wLOv1V2RQUZuioxNXA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu). However, the markings are much shorter and do not run all the way to the bottom.
text_zh: 電線桿幾乎都有這種**黑黃**斜紋標記，而且一路漆到桿子底部。
註：[南韓](https://www.google.com/maps/@36.1050385,128.4118405,3a,18.9y,354.87h,62.54t,0.72r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfnv3wLOv1V2RQUZuioxNXA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也看得到類似標記，但長度短得多，不會一路延伸到底部。

text: These **distribution transformers** that look like boxes are frequently found in Taiwan, especially in urban areas.They are mostly painted in dark green or grey.
text_zh: 這種箱型的**配電變壓器**在台灣很常見，尤其在都市地區，多半漆成深綠色或灰色。

text: Many poles in Taiwan feature these **blue plaques** with strings of letters and numbers that act as precise coordinates.
For an example of how to read the plaques in-game, the only thing that is useful here is the string “E3264”. “BE08” can further narrow down the position but is not practical in-game.
“E” refers to the 50x80km rectangle from this map.
“3264” means that within the rectangle, we are 32% eastward and 64% northward.
[This article](https://wiki.osgeo.org/wiki/Taiwan_Power_Company_grid#1.C3.971m) explains how the string “BE08” can be further used to narrow down the exact coordinates of the telephone pole.
text_zh: 台灣許多電線桿上有這種**藍色標牌**，上面的英數字串其實是精確的座標編碼。
以實戰判讀為例，真正有用的只有「E3264」這串；「BE08」雖然能再縮小範圍，但在遊戲中不實用。
「E」代表此圖中那塊 50×80 公里的方格。
「3264」代表在該方格內，位置在東向 32%、北向 64% 處。
[這篇文章](https://wiki.osgeo.org/wiki/Taiwan_Power_Company_grid#1.C3.971m)說明如何進一步用「BE08」推算出電線桿的精確座標。

text: Similar to the blue plaques found on utility poles, Taiwan also features **stickers** to ID the locations of **lamps**. These can be found on both lampposts and utility poles with lamps attached to them.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 與電線桿上的藍色標牌類似，台灣也有用來標示**路燈**位置的**貼紙**，燈桿與掛有路燈的電線桿上都找得到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: In Yunlin, you can find poles with a **thicker support** below the pole top.
text_zh: 雲林的電線桿在桿頂下方會有**較粗的支撐結構**。

text: These **green square stickers** are typically seen on every pole in Chiayi City.
text_zh: 嘉義市幾乎每根電線桿上都有這種**綠色方形貼紙**。

text: Distribution transformers **raised** **by a dark green holder** are mostly found in New Taipei City and Keelung City.
text_zh: 用**深綠色支架****架高**的配電變壓器主要見於新北市與基隆市。

text: Thai poles are **square **and have small **holes** running vertically up the pole.
NOTE: You will see similar poles in Sri Lanka, Cambodia and Laos. Make sure to look for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 泰國的電線桿呈**方形**，且桿身上有垂直排列的小**孔洞**。
註：你在斯里蘭卡、柬埔寨和寮國也能看到類似的電線桿。猜測前務必尋找其他線索。

text: Street light poles have **red-and-black** or **black-and-white** stripes on the bottom.
text_zh: 路燈桿底部有**紅黑相間**或**黑白相間**的條紋。

text: Regular poles with a Chilean style **indent **are found around Bangkok.
NOTE: Larger and thicker poles with indents are found on [highways](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8tzw2wz1WYcVC83R8) all throughout the country.
text_zh: 具有智利風格**凹痕**的普通電線桿常見於曼谷周邊。
注意：帶有凹痕的更大、更粗的電線桿可以在全國各地的[高速公路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8tzw2wz1WYcVC83R8)上找到。

text: Insulators with **7 or more ridges** are found in the southern half of the peninsula, as well as highways in Chiang Rai and Phayao.
NOTE: In the north, you may still find 5 or 6 ridges on insulators, as these are the standard amount throughout the country.
text_zh: 具有 **7 個或更多脊棱**的絕緣子可以在半島南部的一半地區，以及清萊和帕堯（Phayao）的高速公路上找到。
注意：在北部，你可能仍會找到帶有 5 或 6 個脊棱的絕緣子，因為這些是全國的標準數量。

text: Poles with only **one insulator **on the crossbar can be found from south on the peninsula to Ranong and Chumphon.
text_zh: 橫擔上只有**一個絕緣子**的電線桿可以從半島南部一直找到拉廊和春蓬（Chumphon）。

text: Conversely, poles with **two insulators** on the crossbar can be found in the rest of the country.
text_zh: 相反，橫擔上有**兩個絕緣子**的電線桿可以在該國的其他地區找到。

text: Snow poles usually feature a colour sequence of black-orange-black-white from top to bottom, with small red reflectors.
text_zh: 雪桿通常從上到下呈現黑-橘-黑-白的顏色順序，並附有小型的紅色反光片。

text: Metal poles, either in the shape of a **ladder** or with a **mesh** pattern, are extremely common in Turkey.
text_zh: 金屬桿在土耳其極為常見，形狀呈**梯形**或具有**網狀**圖案。

text: In the European part of Turkey, except Istanbul, utility poles, and other electrical infrastructure, will have a 6 digit code, which is often seen on a small pole plate under the yellow electricity warning plate.
text_zh: 在土耳其的歐洲部分（伊斯坦堡除外），電線桿和其他電力基礎設施會有一個 6 位數的編號，通常可以在黃色電力警告牌下方的金屬小牌上看到。

text: Ukraine primarily uses **square concrete poles**. They can have a variety of different pole tops, and sometimes have white paint at the bottom.
These poles are similar to the ones found in other post-Soviet countries like Russia and Lithuania.
text_zh: 烏克蘭主要使用**方形混凝土電線桿**。它們可能搭配各種不同的桿頂，有時底部會塗上白漆。
這些電線桿與俄羅斯和立陶宛等其他後蘇聯國家發現的電線桿相似。

text: Poles often have **diagonal support beams**.
text_zh: 電線桿通常帶有**斜向支撐樑**。

text: You can also find wooden poles, sometimes with **concrete support blocks** at their base.
text_zh: 你也可以找到木製電線桿，其基座 parfois 帶有**混凝土支撐塊**。

text: **Red soil** can be seen on some ultra-rural dirt tracks around the iron mine in Kryvyi Rih, due to mining activity. [Brazilian-style poles](https://goo.gl/maps/V7X5h9Sd5TYebmv86) can also be seen, making locations around the mine very convincing bait. The foliage, however, will be significantly less tropical, and a long antenna can be seen.
text_zh: 由於採礦活動，克里維里赫鐵礦周圍的一些極度鄉村土路上可以看到**紅土**。也可以看到[巴西風格的電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/V7X5h9Sd5TYebmv86)，使得礦場周圍的地點非常具有迷惑性。然而，植被的熱帶風情會顯著減少，並且可以看到長天線。

text: These poles, with a **red band** across them, are unique to Kryvyi Rih.
text_zh: 這些帶有**紅色橫條紋**的電線桿是克里維里赫特有的。

text: Electricity poles in the UAE are mostly made of **dark brown wood**. The pole tops consist of **three insulators**, symmetrically attached to a **horizontal metal bar**.
NOTE: Similar poletops can be found in Oman. Jordanian poletops may look similar, but they are usually made of grey concrete, and the insulators are more spaced out.
text_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國的電線桿大多由**深棕色木材**製成。桿頂由**三個絕緣子**組成，對稱地固定在**水平金屬橫桿**上。
注意：在阿曼可以找到類似的桿頂。約旦的桿頂看起來可能很像，但它們通常由灰色混凝土製成，且絕緣子之間的間距較大。

text: The UK uses **wooden** poles. Pole steps bolted on the side of the pole are very common. These pole steps are shaped like a series of thin horizontal metal rods.
NOTE: Ireland also commonly uses wooden poles with pole steps.
text_zh: 英國使用**木製**電線桿。釘在電線桿側面的爬桿階梯非常常見。這些爬桿階梯形狀像一系列細小的水平金屬桿。
注意：愛爾蘭也普遍使用帶有爬桿階梯的木製電線桿。

text: Poles in the UK occasionally have a **metal crossbar** near the top with two diagonal supports forming a triangle shape.
NOTE: Ireland, as well as Sweden and Finland also use similar crossbars on some poles.
text_zh: 英國的電線桿頂部附近偶爾會有一個**金屬橫桿**，帶有兩個形成三角形的對角支撐。
注意：愛爾蘭以及瑞典和芬蘭也在一些電線桿上使用類似的橫桿。

text: The **yellow warning stickers** on utility poles can be a good way to distinguish between the UK and Ireland.
The most important difference is that UK stickers feature a guy getting zapped by a lightning bolt.

The [Irish stickers](https://goo.gl/maps/bzrUc5Wo1QrrhxD76) usually have a lightning bolt, but lack the guy getting zapped. They also often have an extra second rectangular sticker with a black outline, below the lightning bolt.
text_zh: 電線桿上的**黃色警告貼紙**是區分英國和愛爾蘭的好方法。
最重要的區別在於英國的貼紙上有一個人被閃電擊中的圖案。
[愛爾蘭的貼紙](https://goo.gl/maps/bzrUc5Wo1QrrhxD76)通常有一個閃電圖案，但沒有被電擊的人。它們通常還在閃電下方有一個帶有黑色外框的額外長方形貼紙。

text: Pedestrian crossing signs are almost non-existent in the UK. Instead, pedestrian crossings will often have these distinctive **black and white striped poles**, with a yellow light bulb on top.
NOTE: These signposts are also common in Ireland.
text_zh: 英國幾乎不存在行人穿越道標誌。取而代之的是，行人穿越道通常會有這些獨特的**黑白相間電線桿**，頂部帶有一個黃色燈泡。
注意：這些路標在愛爾蘭也很常見。

text: Warning stickers **wrapped** all the way around the utility pole are specific to Northern Ireland.
text_zh: **環繞**整個電線桿的警告貼紙是北愛爾蘭特有的。

text: The majority of poles and signposts in Birmingham have either **yellow tape** or yellow paint wrapped around them. Lampposts will also usually have this yellow sticker.
text_zh: 伯明罕多數的電線桿和標誌桿上都纏繞著**黃色膠帶**或塗有黃漆。燈桿通常也會貼有這種黃色貼紙。

text: North America primarily uses **wooden utility poles**.
Several European countries also primarily use wooden utility poles. However, a concrete pole in particular is mostly associated with Europe.
In addition, the US and Canada use transformers that are **large metallic cylinders**. This will never be seen in European countries.
text_zh: 北美主要使用**木製電線桿**。
幾個歐洲國家也主要使用木製電線桿。不過，水泥電線桿特別容易讓人聯想到歐洲。
此外，美國和加拿大使用的變壓器是**大型金屬圓柱體**。這在歐洲國家絕對看不到。

text: This style of **insulator**, which is raised slightly **on top** of the utility pole, can be a good clue for the US and Canada. It is not typically found in Europe. It is especially apparent on simple poles with a single insulator.
text_zh: 這種稍微突起於電線桿**頂部**的**絕緣子**風格，可以成為美國和加拿大的良好線索。它在歐洲並不多見。這在只有單一絕緣子的簡單電線桿上特別明顯。

text: Utility poles in most of California have markings at the bottom of the pole that consist of **3 yellow stripes**. Modoc County and Lassen County in the Northeast of the state are the main exceptions.
This design can also be found in the city of [Grants Pass, Oregon](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NQuKzUpPAgSQFZos6).
text_zh: 加州大部分地區的電線桿底部都有由** 3 條黃色條紋**組成的標記。位於該州東北部的莫多克郡和拉森郡是主要的例外。
這種設計也可以在[奧勒岡州格蘭茨帕斯](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NQuKzUpPAgSQFZos6)市找到。

text: A rectangular **white** metal plate, with an orange rectangle and diamond, can be seen on most poles in Wisconsin and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan.
text_zh: 威斯康辛州和密西根州上半島的大多數電線桿上，都可以看到一個長方形的**白色**金屬牌，上面有一個橘色長方形和菱形。

text: PacificCorp pole markings are **thick, yellow, horizontal metal plates** with raised lettering or [black lettering](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pxJzZtogJE7MoRNy6). They can be found alone or with [multiple plates on one pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PYQjVQX1akDg5Wzh8). They are found in Oregon, eastern Idaho, Utah, and Wyoming, and less commonly in California and Washington.
text_zh: PacificCorp 的電線桿標記是**厚實、黃色的水平金屬板**，帶有浮雕字體或[黑色字體](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pxJzZtogJE7MoRNy6)。它們可以單獨出現，也可以[多個金屬板在同一根電線桿上](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PYQjVQX1akDg5Wzh8)。它們分佈在奧勒岡州、愛達荷州東部、猶他州和懷俄明州，在加州和華盛頓州則較少見。

text: Uruguay uses a handful of different utility poles. One very common and useful one are the so-called **trident poles**, which get their name from their distinctive pole tops with three insulators that point upwards.
NOTE: Similar trident poles can be found in the neighbouring Brazilian state of Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 烏拉圭使用多種不同的電線桿。其中一種非常常見且有用的是所謂的**三叉電線桿**，其名稱來自於它們獨特的桿頂，帶有三個朝上的絕緣體。
注意：類似的三叉電線桿可以在鄰近的巴西南大河州找到。

text: You can also see a variety of other pole designs, including:
- Round poles with a pole top consisting of **flat metal sheets**
- **Square** concrete poles.
Both of these pole designs are also good clues for Uruguay.
In addition, you might see simple wooden poles with [one insulator](https://goo.gl/maps/7xGVU84ikAnmChmB7), as well as very rarely some [Argentina-style poles](https://goo.gl/maps/q6KAW3fKBVBTH79q9).
text_zh: 你也可以看到各種其他電線桿設計，包括：
- 桿頂由**扁平金屬板**組成的圓形電線桿
- **方形**混凝土電線桿。
這兩種電線桿設計也是烏拉圭的好線索。
此外，你可能會看到帶有[一個絕緣體](https://goo.gl/maps/7xGVU84ikAnmChmB7)的簡單木桿，以及非常罕見的[阿根廷風格電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/q6KAW3fKBVBTH79q9)。

text: **Holey poles**, with holes either only on the lower half or almost all the way to the top, are common in Vietnam.
NOTE: The only other Asian country that commonly has holey poles is Sri Lanka, where the holes are [significantly larger](https://maps.app.goo.gl/srBQjDH9RRz2uPG48).
text_zh: **帶孔電線桿**（孔洞僅位於下半部或幾乎一路延伸到頂部）在越南很常見。
注意：另一個常見帶孔電線桿的亞洲國家是斯里蘭卡，那裡的孔洞[明顯大得多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/srBQjDH9RRz2uPG48)。

text: Vietnam often has round concrete poles with indents and **small pin holes** near the top.
NOTE: The same type of pole is also common in [Cambodia](https://goo.gl/maps/JdVDH4F2dURiwAew8) as well as in [Taiwan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pzPeYUqFoGAVftCb9).
text_zh: 越南經常有圓形混凝土電線桿，頂部附近有凹痕和**小針孔**。
注意：同類型的電線桿在[柬埔寨](https://goo.gl/maps/JdVDH4F2dURiwAew8)以及[台灣](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pzPeYUqFoGAVftCb9)也很常見。

text: Poletops shaped like **upside down trapezoids** are common in Vietnam.
NOTE: These may look similar to the poletops found in [central and northern Sulawesi](https://maps.app.goo.gl/F77f85pkPtnfWexk6), Indonesia.
text_zh: 形狀像**倒梯形**的電線桿頂在越南很常見。
注意：這些可能看起來類似印尼[中蘇拉威西和北蘇拉威西](https://maps.app.goo.gl/F77f85pkPtnfWexk6)發現的電線桿頂。

text: Double poles, which can be of different varieties, are fairly common in Vietnam.
text_zh: 雙電線桿（可以有不同的種類）在越南相當常見。

text: Utility poles often feature these light grey **electricity boxes**, which can have anywhere from 1 to 4 small indented windows. They have a very characteristic shape, where the bottom part** slopes down **slightly.
text_zh: 電線桿通常具有這些淺灰色的**配電箱**，可能擁有 1 到 4 個帶有凹痕的小窗戶。它們具有非常具代表性的形狀，底部**稍微向下傾斜**。

text: Utility poles with **large holes** along most of the pole are common in northern Vietnam.

NOTE: Do not confuse this with the [regular holey pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xbMJe5paBUuoLzm2A), which is where the holes extend only halfway up the pole. This ½ of the holey pole is found throughout the entirety of Vietnam.
text_zh: 電線桿大部分桿身帶有**大孔**的電線桿在越南北部很常見。
注意：不要將此與[一般的有孔電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xbMJe5paBUuoLzm2A)搞混，後者的孔洞僅延伸到電線桿的一半高度。這種半孔電線桿在全越南各地都可以找到。

text: Round concrete poles usually feature [many pinholes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RfrXtSv9T5Vy5Smg6) on the top half of the pole, however in the north they often feature a minimal amount or even **no pinholes**.
NOTE: Although more rare, pinhole poles may be found in the north.
text_zh: 圓形混凝土電線桿通常在電線桿的上半部有[許多針孔](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RfrXtSv9T5Vy5Smg6)，但是在北部，它們通常只有極少數甚至**沒有針孔**。
注意：雖然較為罕見，但針孔電線桿也可能會在北部找到。

text: Poletops shaped like **upside down trapezoids** are common in central and northern Vietnam.
NOTE: Trapezoidal pole tops may be [off-centre](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hrHUQbXHHTniFB1t9) which is not the same as regular off-centre poles.
text_zh: 形狀像**倒梯形**的桿頂在越南中北部很常見。
注意：梯形桿頂可能是[偏心的](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hrHUQbXHHTniFB1t9)，這與一般的偏心電線桿不同。

text: The trapezoid shaped poletops can sometimes be off-centre. If a utility pole has **three off-centre incomplete trapezoids** then you will be in the north of the country.
text_zh: 梯形形狀的桿頂有時會偏心。如果電線桿有**三個偏心的不完整梯形**，那麼你就在該國的北部。

text: Poletops shaped like a **triangle**, with the support bars underneath the crossbar, are found in southern Vietnam.
NOTE: The middle insulator must be mounted onto the pole itself, rather than on a [metal extension ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7tDNw4eb1L7yeHw29)of the crossbar.
text_zh: 形狀像**三角形**且支撐桿在橫桿下方的桿頂，可在越南南部找到。
注意：中間的絕緣體必須安裝在電線桿本身上，而不是安裝在橫樑的[金屬延伸部分](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7tDNw4eb1L7yeHw29)上。

text: A poletop shaped like an **A above a crossbar** can be found in the centre of the country.
text_zh: 形狀像**橫桿上方一個 A 字**的桿頂可以在該國中部找到。

text: Utility poles with **uneven crossbars**, meaning the crossbar is significantly more to one side of the pole than the other, are found in the south of the country. Sometimes, they are not fully uneven but are more in the style of [Indonesian off-centre poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TiDuQt7tSV8UmA3K7).

NOTE: You may mistake partially [off-centre trapezoid](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ieZHLc3qyVbNUXRz5) poletops for regular off-centre poletops, however any pole with a trapezoid connector belongs in a different category. In the exception, the connector is not a straight bar, rather it is an incomplete trapezoid.
text_zh: 具有**不對稱橫桿**的電線桿（意思是橫桿明顯偏向電線桿的一側）可以在該國南部找到。有時，它們並非完全不對稱，而是更偏向[印尼偏心電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TiDuQt7tSV8UmA3K7)的風格。
注意：你可能會把部分[偏心梯形](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ieZHLc3qyVbNUXRz5)桿頂誤認為一般的偏心桿頂，但任何帶有梯形連接器的電線桿都屬於不同的類別。在例外情況下，連接器不是一根直桿，而是一個不完整的梯形。

text: Thin **bamboo poles** can be found in rural areas of the northwestern mountains.
text_zh: 細長的**竹竿**可以在西北山區的鄉村地區找到。

text: Poles in the northern parts of the country will often have **black pole stickers**, similar to those found in Malaysia but often with a more simple design.
text_zh: 該國北部的電線桿通常會有**黑色電線桿貼紙**，類似於馬來西亞常見的貼紙，但通常設計更為簡單。

text: The A35 is a very recognisable road: there is always a **power line to your west**. It can also be recognised by its grainy asphalt with faded markings. Many small tracks can be found parallel to the road, disappearing into the bushes.
text_zh: A35 是條非常好辨認的道路：**你的西側總是會有一條電線**。它也可以透過帶有褪色標線的粗糙柏油路來辨識。許多與道路平行的小徑最終消失在灌木叢中。

text: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by **extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees** surrounding the road. The first section of the road, between Maun and Shorobe, is paved. But that section can still be identified by the trees, faint road markings, and power lines to the west of the road.
text_zh: 從馬烏恩以北通往 Khwai 的大部分未鋪設道路，可透過道路周圍**極為白皙的沙質土壤與高大的綠樹**來辨認。該道路的第一段（馬烏恩與 Shorobe 之間）已鋪設柏油。但該路段仍可透過樹木、模糊的道路標線以及道路西側的電線來辨認。

text: Southeast of Tshabong, the A20 has been recently repainted and has very **bright yellow lines** and relatively **dark asphalt**. There is a powerline running alongside it to the northeast, it has orange-tan sandy soil, and you can often find patches of yellow flowers.
text_zh: 在 Tshabong 東南部，A20 最近重新繪製了標線，擁有非常**明亮的黃線**與相對**較暗的柏油**。東北側有一條平行延伸的電線，土壤呈橘棕色沙質，且經常可以看到成片的黃花。

text: The road between Nkwanta and Domanko is **unpaved**, with a **powerline** close to the road to your east or northeast. The road itself runs in a general SE-NW direction, through a lush savannah landscape that is typical of central Ghana.

NOTE: In urban areas, there can be a powerline on both sides of the road. In addition, a section of the Salaga-Tamale road has a powerline to the east as well, but the darker soil and moody cloud cover makes it distinguishable.
text_zh: 恩寬塔（Nkwanta）和多曼科（Domanko）之間的道路是**未鋪面道路**，道路東側或東北側緊鄰著**高壓電線**。道路本身大致呈東南-西北走向，穿過迦納中部典型的鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。
註：在市區，道路兩側都可能設有高壓電線。此外，薩拉加-塔馬利公路的一段路東側也有高壓電線，但較暗的土壤和陰沉的雲層覆蓋使其得以區分。

text: Road 37 travels in a generally northwest direction through a very generic, flat desert landscape. The angle is one of the best clues for this road. On the southern half, a [big power line](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8) is visible to the northeast, while on the northern half, you can find distinct [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A).
text_zh: 37 號公路大致呈西北走向，穿過非常平淡、平坦的沙漠景觀。角度是這條道路最好的線索之一。在南半部，東北方可見[大型輸電線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8)；而在北半部，則可以找到明顯的[日落街景](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A)。

text: Just south of Shalim, you’ll find a stretch of** overcast** coverage, along with a power line to the west of the road, but only north of the [plateau](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nCyXdi6WiQmWz4Hn9).
text_zh: 就在沙利姆（Shalim）南方，你會發現一段 **陰天** 的街景覆蓋，道路西側有一條電線，但僅限於[高原](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nCyXdi6WiQmWz4Hn9)以北。

text: The road southeast of Ubar has a general northwest bound angle, along with a power line to the left of the road. You will often see signs of life in the form of farms or buildings on this road.

NOTE: Don’t mix this up with the 37, which has a similar angle, but is [more desolate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7) and can have [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9).
text_zh: 烏巴爾（Ubar）東南方的道路大致呈西北走向，道路左側有一條電線。在這條路上，你經常會看到農場或建築物等有人居住的跡象。
注意：不要把這條路跟 37 號公路搞混了，37 號公路的角度相似，但[更為荒涼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7)，且可能帶有[日落街景覆蓋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9)。

text: The **only paved road** with coverage outside Kampala can be found here. The pavement almost entirely lacks the red tinge which is typical for most roads in the country. The road has white, solid outer lines and a yellow middle line.
A power line runs parallel to the road, to your east. To your north, you will be able to see hills.
text_zh: 坎帕拉以外擁有街景覆蓋的**唯一鋪面道路**就在這裡。這條柏油路幾乎完全沒有該國多數道路典型的泛紅色調。道路兩側有白色實線外緣線，中間則是黃色中線。
一條輸電線路與道路平行，位於你的東側。在你的北側，則可以看到群山。

intro.lead: 電線桿是全世界差異最大也最好記的人造物
body: 看四個地方：桿子材質（木、混凝土、金屬）、橫擔的層數與形狀、礙子的顏色與數量、以及變壓器與分接頭的裝法。這些組合在各國幾乎不重複，熟了以後單看一根桿子就能定國。
北美多用木桿、歐洲多混凝土、日本用圓形混凝土配多層橫擔並常見黃色編號牌。同一國內部也可能分區域差異，日本各地方的變壓器裝法就完全不同。
